name: tengu_1p_event_batch_config
what: Sets how the first-party event logger batches events.

name: tengu_agents_md_mod
what: Turns on the built-in mod that loads AGENTS.md as project instructions (on by default).

name: tengu_agentview_inherit_mode_demote
what: Makes a forked agent-view session mark its permission mode as inherited.
effect: opening the agent view from a session On, the session's permission mode is handed on as inherited (the --inherit-permission-mode flag) rather than chosen, and an inherited default mode is dropped when the agent view relaunches.

name: tengu_alder_compass
what: Shows the /powerup tutorial tip to new users who have started Claude Code fewer than 10 times.

name: tengu_amber_creek
what: Turns the fullscreen (no-flicker) terminal UI on for a cohort when neither settings.tui nor CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER has decided.

name: tengu_amber_ferry
what: Lets attachment resolution run ahead of file downloads in remote sessions.

name: tengu_amber_flint
what: Agent teams turn on only with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS or --agent-teams. This gate, on by default, can still turn them off.

name: tengu_amber_kestrel
what: Lifts the cap on concurrent subagents.

name: tengu_amber_lark
what: Appends a dimmed note to the usage text. What the note says was not read.

name: tengu_amber_lattice
what: Lists the plugins that are given the user's Anthropic OAuth token or API key. By the variable names, the credential goes into the plugin's environment.

name: tengu_amber_lynx
what: Read by the /feedback submit dialog. What it changes there was not read.

name: tengu_amber_moleskin
what: A table of compaction precompute fractions keyed by context-window size, with REPL and SDK values. A missing or malformed table falls back to one fraction.
effect: A table that does not parse logs a malformed-table event once. The served value is a table whose keys are default or a context-window size and whose entries hold a repl and an sdk fraction below 1; a missing, malformed or unmatched table falls back to tengu_amber_rokovoko, 0.2 by default.

name: tengu_amber_prism
what: Appends extra guidance text to the "Tool loaded." message.

name: tengu_amber_redwood2
what: Holds a string that takes precedence over tengu_amber_redwood3. By the model name defined beside it, the string is a model id that replaces a built-in one.

name: tengu_amber_redwood3
what: Holds a string read only when tengu_amber_redwood2 is empty. By the model name defined beside it, the string is a model id that replaces a built-in one.

name: tengu_amber_rokovoko
what: Sets the default precompute fraction for compaction (0.2).

name: tengu_amber_sentinel
what: Adds prompt text that points live watching to the Monitor tool, in the Bash tool and the cron scheduling tool descriptions.

name: tengu_amber_sextant
what: Adds the "you are operating autonomously" instruction for unattended runs.

name: tengu_amber_tally
what: Holds the five-hour credit figures (credits per million tokens) that the resume-return nudge uses.

name: tengu_amber_tollgate
what: Allows plugin install links that install from source. With the gate off, such a link tells the user to type /plugin install instead.

name: tengu_ant_yolo_equiv_strip_config
what: Strips permission rules equivalent to full bypass for selected entrypoints.

name: tengu_async_goblet
what: Turns on the SDK-hosted upload mode for brief attachments.

name: tengu_atomic_ocean
what: Turns on gzip compression of request bodies, together with tengu_gzip_request_bodies.

name: tengu_attempt_decision_shadow
what: Runs the new streaming retry-decision logic in shadow.

name: tengu_auto_mode_config
what: Holds the auto-mode configuration object (availability and classifier options).

name: tengu_auto_mode_worktree_fast_path
what: Turns on a fast path in auto mode for paths in other worktrees.

name: tengu_ax_screen_reader
what: Lets the server veto screen-reader mode. The mode itself is turned on by --ax-screen-reader, CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER or settings.axScreenReader.

name: tengu_ax_sr_arrow_nav
what: Turns on arrow-key navigation in screen-reader mode.

name: tengu_bad_survey_transcript_ask_config
what: Sets when and how to ask for the transcript after a "bad" survey rating.

name: tengu_basalt_meadow
what: Records terminal glyph-atlas data.

name: tengu_basalt_spur
what: Going by the prompt-cache TTL code beside it, sets a one-hour cache TTL for some requests.

name: tengu_bg_attach_stall_ms
what: Sets the stall timeout when attaching to a background session (default 5000 ms).

name: tengu_bg_attach_upgrade
what: Turns on the upgrade on background attach. The background prewarm burst and prewarm sweep also run only while it is on.

name: tengu_bg_binary_takeover
what: Lets a newer client binary take over an older background daemon.

name: tengu_bg_classifier_config
what: Holds the settings for the background-session status classifier (small fast model, no thinking, debounce).

name: tengu_bg_leftarrow_inprocess
what: Makes sending a session to the background with the left arrow run in process.

name: tengu_bg_low_mem_mb
what: Sets the low-memory threshold for background workers (default 1024 MB).

name: tengu_bg_prewarm_burst_concurrency
what: Sets how many background workers the prewarm burst starts at once (default 3).

name: tengu_bg_prewarm_burst_delay_ms
what: Sets the delay before the background prewarm burst (default 15000 ms).

name: tengu_bg_prewarm_per_sweep
what: Sets how many background workers are prewarmed per sweep (default 3).

name: tengu_bg_revival_guard
what: Going by the name and the restart message beside it, guards the automatic restart of a background session whose process exited.

name: tengu_bg_spare_enable
what: Keeps a spare background worker ready.

name: tengu_bg_worker_ctty
what: Makes background workers acquire a controlling terminal (daemon backend).

name: tengu_binary_balloon
what: Sends tool schemas from a recorded snapshot instead of rebuilding them.

name: tengu_birch_kettle
what: Turns on the built-in skill that answers questions about Claude Code from its docs.

name: tengu_birch_lantern
what: Picks how the /powerup onboarding prompt reaches new users. The values are "off" (the default), "banner" and "step".

name: tengu_bracken_sluice
what: Lets a classifier route Artifact comment threads to an act lane or a pipeline lane.

name: tengu_bramble_lintel
what: Runs memory extraction every N turns (default 1).

name: tengu_brass_lantern
what: Turns on the live identity resolution that the policy-limits and managed-settings cache checks use.

name: tengu_brass_plover
what: Turns on the live presence connection for Artifacts. With it off, presence reports "flag_off" and no connection opens.

name: tengu_brass_sled
what: Detects installed build tools for the PowerShell tool prompt.

name: tengu_breezy_crescent
what: Going by the Monitor prompt text it switches, makes every Monitor watch expire after its timeout and need re-arming. It is pinned per session.

name: tengu_breezy_fairy
what: Going by the code it gates, lets the client ask for an elevated security tier for a cloud session, with device proof headers attached.

name: tengu_brick_follow
what: Going by the environment variable that forces it on, forwards interim voice transcripts as typed text.

name: tengu_bridge_apply_server_session_config
what: Applies the server's session config to Remote Control sessions.

name: tengu_bridge_attestation_enforce
what: Enforces device attestation for Remote Control messages.

name: tengu_bridge_attestation_enforce_config
what: Holds the settings for Remote Control attestation enforcement.

name: tengu_bridge_auth_revive
what: Named for reviving Remote Control authentication after it lapses. What it does was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_child_auto_mode
what: By its name, makes Remote Control child sessions start in auto mode.

name: tengu_bridge_child_auto_over_settings
what: By its name, lets a Remote Control child session's auto mode take precedence over the user's settings.

name: tengu_bridge_child_file_upload
what: Turns on file upload from Remote Control child sessions.

name: tengu_bridge_child_machine_settings
what: Named for the machine settings of Remote Control child sessions. What it does with them was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_child_tool_diff
what: Sends tool diffs from Remote Control child sessions.

name: tengu_bridge_host_declined_end
what: Going by the name alone, ends a Remote Control session when its host declines it.

name: tengu_bridge_host_profile
what: Picks how much of a host profile is shared with Remote Control, such as installed toolchains and OS and GPU versions. The default is "off".

name: tengu_bridge_inbox_pointer_boundary
what: Tracks the unread pointer of the Remote Control session inbox.

name: tengu_bridge_initialize_commands
what: Sends slash commands when a Remote Control session initializes.

name: tengu_bridge_min_version
what: Sets the minimum client version for Remote Control (default 2.1.270).

name: tengu_bridge_owner_pinned_end
what: Named as a switch for ending owner-pinned Remote Control sessions. What it does was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_partial_messages
what: Its name says it streams partial messages over Remote Control. Where it is used was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_placeholder_sweep
what: Sweeps placeholder Remote Control session records.

name: tengu_bridge_poll_interval_config
what: Sets the poll intervals for Remote Control.

name: tengu_bridge_rc_child_artifact
what: By its name, turns on Artifacts in Remote Control child sessions.

name: tengu_bridge_rc_child_auto_compact
what: The name points to auto-compact in Remote Control child sessions. What it changes there was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_rc_child_idle_exit_ms
what: Sets the idle exit time for Remote Control child sessions (default 24 h).

name: tengu_bridge_rc_child_restart_resume
what: Named for resuming a Remote Control child session after a restart. The code that uses it was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_rc_projects_hint
what: Named for a projects hint in Remote Control. What the hint shows was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_recovery_patience
what: By its name, makes the Remote Control bridge wait longer before it gives up on recovery.

name: tengu_bridge_repl_v2_config
what: Holds the Remote Control (REPL bridge v2) settings for retries and minimum version.

name: tengu_bridge_repl_v2_cse_shim_enabled
what: Named as the switch for a compatibility shim in Remote Control v2. What the shim does was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_requires_action_details
what: Adds tool details to Remote Control "requires action" requests.

name: tengu_bridge_resume_respects_local_owner
what: On resume, Remote Control does not take over a bridge session that another local process still serves.
effect: Remote Control start-up after a resume On, a bridge session named in the resumed transcript and still served by another local process is left alone, unless Remote Control was turned on explicitly and the start is not a revive.

name: tengu_bridge_selfheal_heartbeats
what: Named as the switch for self-healing heartbeats on the Remote Control bridge.

name: tengu_bridge_signed_out_neutral
what: By its name, makes Remote Control treat a signed-out user neutrally. What neutral means in code was not read.

name: tengu_bridge_subagent_frames
what: Forwards subagent frames over Remote Control.

name: tengu_bridge_subagent_text
what: Forwards subagent text over Remote Control.

name: tengu_bridge_unarchive_on_resume
what: Unarchives the code session when resuming over Remote Control.

name: tengu_bright_lake
what: Turns on the dangerous-rm check for possibly empty variable expansions. Only a false value served by the server turns it off.

name: tengu_brindle_causeway
what: Picks the MCP SDK runtime generation, with on meaning v2 and off meaning v1.

name: tengu_brisk_meadow
what: Turns on inline tools mode when CLAUDE_CODE_INLINE_TOOLS is unset.

name: tengu_brook_heron
what: Holds extra instruction text from client data, applied per effort level.

name: tengu_bubbly_harbor
what: Adds provenance notes to workflow-run prompts (for example, that the run was started by an automated trigger).

name: tengu_bubbly_meteor
what: Going by the code beside it, lets the client move running tool calls to the background on its own. It also needs tengu_velvet_panda on.

name: tengu_buzzing_lightning
what: Turns on the Artifact REPL path.

name: tengu_buzzing_pike
what: Sets the gzip mode (0, 1 or 2) for large /v1/messages request bodies.

name: tengu_byte_stream_idle_timeout_ms
what: Sets the idle timeout for the API byte-stream watchdog (first-party default 180000 ms, clamped 10 s to 30 min).

name: tengu_c4e_slash_upsell
what: Turns on the C4E upsell slash command. By the name, the command advertises a C4E plan to users who lack it.

name: tengu_calm_noodle
what: Announces the messages kept after a compaction.

name: tengu_canary
what: Names the canary version offered to external installs.

name: tengu_ccr_bridge
what: Controls whether Remote Control is available.

name: tengu_ccr_bundle_max_bytes
what: Sets the maximum size of the git bundle used to seed a cloud session.

name: tengu_ccr_bundle_seed_enabled
what: Lets a cloud session be seeded from a git bundle of the local repository.

name: tengu_ccr_classifier_keepalive_enabled
what: Sends keepalives while the auto-mode classifier holds a cloud session call (needs CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SEND_KEEPALIVES).

name: tengu_ccr_disk_watchdog
what: Turns on a disk-space watchdog in cloud sessions.

name: tengu_ccr_drop_unwatched_stream_events
what: Drops cloud stream events nobody is watching.
effect: partial-message stream events of a cloud session On, while the server reports nobody watching, partial-message stream events are dropped instead of buffered and uploaded.

name: tengu_ccr_event_hold_enabled
what: Passed to the cloud session transport as its eventHoldEnabled option. By that name, it lets the transport hold some events back.

name: tengu_ccr_exclude_dynamic_restore_killswitch
what: Skips restoring the excludeDynamicSections setting from the prior worker when a cloud session restarts.

name: tengu_ccr_handoff_metadata
what: Reports worktree state and branches as handoff metadata.

name: tengu_ccr_hook_keepalive_enabled
what: Sends keepalives while hooks run in cloud sessions (needs CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SEND_KEEPALIVES).

name: tengu_ccr_idle_heartbeat
what: Advertises heartbeat-probe support for idle cloud sessions.

name: tengu_ccr_keepalive_after_stop_enabled
what: Sends keepalive frames after a turn stops in cloud sessions.

name: tengu_ccr_mcp_set_servers_defer_connect
what: Defers MCP server connections when the host sets servers in a cloud session (off, on or cold).

name: tengu_ccr_mcp_set_servers_defer_connect_relay
what: Applies the same MCP connection deferral to relayed set-servers requests.

name: tengu_ccr_no_subscriber_flush_ms
what: Sets the flush delay for stream events with no subscriber (default 0).

name: tengu_ccr_no_subscriber_hold_ms
what: Sets the hold time for uploads with no subscriber (default 0).

name: tengu_ccr_orphan_restore_wake
what: Wakes restored orphaned agents after a cloud session restore.

name: tengu_ccr_orphan_restore_wake_shells
what: Includes shells when waking restored orphans.

name: tengu_ccr_plugin_refresh_in_idle_enabled
what: Refreshes plugins while a cloud session is idle instead of waiting for the install sync.

name: tengu_ccr_reactivation_beat
what: Sends a heartbeat on reactivation.
effect: heartbeats of a cloud session On, the first activity after an idle stretch sends a heartbeat at once, provided the server has granted a longer idle heartbeat interval, the beat is armed and no heartbeat drew a 429 within the seed interval.

name: tengu_ccr_reconnect_beat
what: Sends a heartbeat on a stale reconnect.

name: tengu_ccr_replay_acks_at_request_dispatch
what: Replays message acknowledgements at request dispatch in cloud sessions.

name: tengu_ccr_sdk_mcp_remote_manifests
what: Turns on SDK MCP manifests over remote transports when writers are owner-only.

name: tengu_ccr_skip_redundant_heartbeat
what: Skips redundant heartbeats.

name: tengu_ccr_sse_keepalive_max_interval_s
what: Sets the maximum SSE keepalive interval (default 0).

name: tengu_ccr_stream_event_flush_ms
what: Sets the flush interval for cloud stream events.

name: tengu_ccr_stream_first_flush_ms
what: Sets the first flush delay for cloud stream events (default 0).

name: tengu_ccr_stream_flush_on_first_delta
what: Flushes the cloud stream on the first delta.

name: tengu_ccr_subagent_skip_on_delta
what: By its name, skips subagent transcripts when a cloud session is hydrated from a delta.

name: tengu_ccr_upload_hold_marker
what: Passed to the cloud session transport as its uploadHoldMarker option. By that name, it marks uploads that are being held back.

name: tengu_ccr_upload_trim
what: Holds the trimming settings for cloud session uploads.

name: tengu_ccr_v2_bridge_create_cli
what: Named for creating Remote Control sessions through the v2 API from the CLI. What it changes was not read.

name: tengu_ccr_v2_send_events_cli
what: The name points to sending session events through the v2 API from the CLI.

name: tengu_ccr_v2_session_crud_cli
what: Going by the name, routes the CLI's session create, update and delete calls through the v2 API.

name: tengu_cedar_ember
what: Sets the offer to use a usage-limit reset early (enabled flag, version and wording).

name: tengu_cedar_lantern
what: Adds the "act, do not re-derive established facts" instruction to the system prompt.

name: tengu_cedar_lattice
what: Picks the dispatch v2 S route for API requests other than auxiliary ones, unless tengu_dreamy_frost chose v2 D. What the route changes was not read.

name: tengu_cedar_marsh
what: Turns on reduced motion for some accounts when the user has not set prefersReducedMotion.

name: tengu_cedar_plume
what: Shows a tip that points users to claude.ai/design.

name: tengu_chair_sermon
what: Folds reminders together (reminderFold).

name: tengu_cheerful_horizon
what: Going by the code beside it, turns on a check of whether the account has a GitHub web connection.

name: tengu_chomp_inflection
what: Turns prompt suggestions (a suggested next prompt) on by default.

name: tengu_chomp_sable
what: Reports why prompt suggestions are paused (host paused, not user started).

name: tengu_chomp_thaw
what: Skips the cache-write check for prompt suggestions.

name: tengu_chrome_auto_enable
what: Turns the Claude in Chrome integration on automatically.

name: tengu_chrome_install_upsell
what: Shows an upsell to install the Chrome extension.

name: tengu_chrome_tab_group_close
what: Closes the Chrome tab group of a session.

name: tengu_cicada_nap_ms
what: Sets the minimum gap between startup prefetches (default 0).

name: tengu_cinder_plover
what: Holds extra text in the AskUserQuestion tool prompt for lean prompts.

name: tengu_cinder_swift
what: Sets the push-notification mode for permission prompts (interrupt or off).

name: tengu_cinder_wren
what: Holds extra text appended to the AskUserQuestion tool prompt.

name: tengu_classifier_disabled_surfaces
what: Holds a comma-separated list of surfaces where the session classifier is off.

name: tengu_classifier_summary_kill
what: Removes the summary output from the session classifier on every surface.

name: tengu_classifier_summary_llm_emit
what: Uses the LLM classifier for session summaries.

name: tengu_claudeai_plugins_sync_enabled
what: Syncs plugins from the claude.ai account (setting syncClaudeAiPlugins, org policy allow_account_plugins_sync).

name: tengu_claudeai_skills_sync_enabled
what: Syncs skills from the claude.ai account (setting syncClaudeAiSkills, org policy allow_account_skills_sync).

name: tengu_claudeai_skills_sync_interval_minutes
what: Sets the interval of the claude.ai skill sync (default 10 minutes, clamped 5 to 1440).

name: tengu_claudeai_skills_sync_shared_round
what: Read by the claude.ai skill sync. By its name, it makes the sync run as one shared round.

name: tengu_clever_orbit
what: Takes the WebFetch tool away from the main conversation. Web pages are read through a built-in web-fetch agent instead.
effect: the tool and agent lists of a session On, the built-in web-fetch agent joins the agent list and WebFetch leaves the main tool list, unless a policy, a simple session or a disabled WebFetch rules it out. the error the model gets when it calls WebFetch while the web-fetch agent stands in for it WebFetch is not available directly in this context — use the Agent tool with subagent_type: "web-fetch" to read web pages instead.

name: tengu_cobalt_awning
what: Sets the full-check interval for cloud workers in seconds (default -1, off).

name: tengu_cobalt_harbor
what: Turns Remote Control on by default when org policy says nothing.

name: tengu_cobalt_harbor_notice
what: Shows a notice that Remote Control turned on automatically.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth
what: Turns on the Artifacts feature (its default depends on the auth type).

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_alder
what: Allows deleting Artifacts.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_aspen
what: Would turn on Artifact preview. In this build the preview module is absent and the gate is never reached.
effect: the Artifact preview availability check The check that the preview module is compiled in fails before the gate is read, so neither the gate nor CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_PREVIEW changes anything in this build.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_bracken
what: Turns on multi-file Artifacts.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_bryony
what: Turns on what its telemetry event calls five-class asks for Artifacts, latched once per session. What the five classes are was not read.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_damson
what: Splits the Artifact tool into separate comments and data tools.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_dataviz
what: Adds chart and diagram guidance to the Artifact design guidance.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_fern
what: By its name and the frame-contract URL beside it, fetches the latest Artifact frame contract.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_larch
what: Turns on Artifact types (the type catalog and creating an Artifact from a type).

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_linden
what: Allows starting an Artifact from a type in cloud sessions.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_sedge
what: Allows reading public Artifacts from outside the organisation.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_sill
what: Sets a whole-number limit for Artifacts, capped at a built-in maximum. What the limit counts was not read.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_sloe
what: Picks which text variant (v0, v1, v2) of the Artifact tool description is used.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_sorb
what: Turns on a design guard when publishing HTML Artifacts.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_sorrel
what: Must be on for Artifacts to be available, along with tengu_cobalt_plinth_madder outside hosted sessions. It is on by default.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_willow
what: Named, like its CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_OPEN_ACTION override, for an open action in the Artifact tool. What the action does was not read.

name: tengu_cobalt_plinth_woad
what: By its name and its CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_QUICKSTART override, turns on the quickstart action of the Artifact tool.

name: tengu_cobalt_ridge
what: On Windows with Git Bash available, also offers the PowerShell tool.

name: tengu_cobalt_wren
what: Turns LLM session summaries back to the heuristic.

name: tengu_compact_cache_prefix
what: Reuses the prompt-cache prefix when compacting.

name: tengu_compiled_acorn
what: Changes how messages relayed from a bound Slack thread are framed in the prompt.

name: tengu_compressed_river
what: Turns on the IDE diff-view dialog over the bridge.

name: tengu_concurrent_candle
what: Named, like its CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_START_KIT override, for an Artifact start kit. What the kit holds was not read.

name: tengu_concurrent_moonbeam
what: Turns on a stdout guard used when the terminal title is disabled or traffic is essential-only.

name: tengu_concurrent_shore
what: Going by the activity-summary code beside it, groups concurrent searches and reads into one summary line.

name: tengu_context_usage_bulk_counts
what: Counts context usage in bulk for the full context report.

name: tengu_coordinator_panel
what: Turns on the coordinator panel in interactive sessions.

name: tengu_copper_hinge_wren
what: By its name and its CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_HOT override, turns on hot updates of published Artifacts.

name: tengu_copper_thistle
what: Read by the prompt footer when it builds mode labels and the task list. What it changes there was not read.

name: tengu_coral_anchor
what: Warns when an MCP server question has gone unanswered for minutes.

name: tengu_cosmic_lake
what: Hides the five-hour rate-limit warning.

name: tengu_cosmic_shore
what: Turns on a time limit for commands run in the background, capped at a built-in maximum.

name: tengu_cowork_auto_mode_include_allowed_write_mcp
what: Makes auto mode also check destructive MCP calls that an MCP server policy allowed.

name: tengu_cowork_chrome_automode_default
what: Turns on the Chrome classifier floor in auto mode.

name: tengu_cozy_dusk
what: Sets the telemetry export interval (default 300000 ms).

name: tengu_cozy_teapot
what: Picks the Bash-first steering variant, strict or relaxed.

name: tengu_crimson_vector
what: Raises the maximum image size sent to the first-party API.

name: tengu_cuddly_willow
what: Acts as a second cross-session messaging switch and is refused until feature flags have loaded.

name: tengu_curious_lake
what: Turns on a deny rule for cmd-style recursive deletes run from the PowerShell tool. Only a false value served by the server turns it off.

name: tengu_curious_tower
what: Turns on the live tether (threads) feature. CLAUDE_CODE_TETHER_LIVE decides instead when it is set.
effect: each model request of a first-party session Each request is compared with the previous one by model, system prompt, tools and message history, and either continues the same thread or starts a new one. Logs a thread decision event for each model request, with the reason and the fields that changed.

name: tengu_curious_tower_stateless_models
what: Holds a comma-separated list of models treated as stateless for the live tether.

name: tengu_daemon_refuse_stale_upgrade

name: tengu_daemon_upgrade_defer_busy
what: Makes the background daemon defer its upgrade restart while workers are busy.

name: tengu_dapper_brooks

Bash tool description, in auto or bypass-permissions mode: this passage is removed and only its Communication line stays IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user:

 - Read files: Use Read (NOT cat/head/tail)
 - Edit files: Use Edit (NOT sed/awk)
 - Write files: Use Write (NOT echo >/cat <<EOF)
 - Communication: Output text directly (NOT echo/printf)
While the Bash tool can do similar things, it’s better to use the built-in tools as they provide a better user experience and make it easier to review tool calls and give permission. auto-mode system reminder: appended in auto mode, sent on its own in bypass-permissions mode (the strict wording; tengu_cozy_teapot can pick a relaxed one) Do your work through the Bash tool wherever it can accomplish the job: read files with cat, head, or sed -n, search with grep and find, and make file changes with sed, heredocs, or short scripts, rather than using the dedicated Read, Edit, or Write tools. Fall back to a dedicated tool only when Bash genuinely cannot do the job. the reminder sent when auto mode is exited: in its steer-only form the sentence follows the first sentence, You have exited auto mode.; in its ordinary form it ends the paragraph, after the sentence about asking clarifying questions Resume using the dedicated tools for file reads, searches, and edits. a foreground Bash command in auto or bypass-permissions mode With the bashEditDiffEnabled setting unset, the Bash tool records the file changes a foreground command makes as an edit diff. CLAUDE_CODE_THRIFTY_SONIC decides when it is set; otherwise the session is assigned forced, none or cohort from the model's own configuration and client data, and only a cohort session reads the served value, which defaults to off.

what: Sets the Google Cloud project id for Vertex AI, used when GCLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT are unset.

name: ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID
what: Sets the workspace id used with workload identity federation credentials.

name: API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT
what: Controls whether the HTTP client keeps its own idle timeout on API requests when a body watchdog is active.

name: API_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for API requests in milliseconds (default 600000).

name: APPDATA
what: Gives the Windows roaming application data folder. The client uses it to locate per-user install paths such as the Chrome native host.

name: APP_URL
what: A value containing ondigitalocean.app marks the deployment environment as DigitalOcean App Platform in telemetry.

name: AUTOMODE_DECISION_LOG
what: When 1, auto-mode classifier decisions are appended to .automode_decisions.jsonl in the config directory.

name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
what: Sets the AWS access key id used for Bedrock and other AWS-backed providers.

name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
what: Sets the AWS account id attached to credentials read from the environment by the bundled AWS SDK.

name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
what: Sets the bearer token for Amazon Bedrock. While it is set, the AWS credential chain is not used.

name: AWS_CA_BUNDLE
what: Sets the CA bundle path for AWS tools. When the client supplies its own CA bundle and this is unset, it sets it in sandboxed subprocess environments.

name: AWS_CONFIG_FILE
what: Sets the path of the AWS shared config file used to resolve region and credentials.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN
what: Sets the authorization header value the bundled AWS SDK sends to the container credentials endpoint.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN_FILE
what: Sets the file holding the authorization token the bundled AWS SDK sends to the container credentials endpoint.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI
what: Sets the full URI of the container credentials endpoint used by the AWS credential chain.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI
what: Sets the relative URI of the ECS container credentials endpoint used by the AWS credential chain.

name: AWS_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRATION
what: Sets the expiry time of AWS credentials read from the environment by the bundled AWS SDK.

name: AWS_CREDENTIAL_SCOPE
what: Sets the credential scope attached to AWS credentials read from the environment by the bundled AWS SDK.

name: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
what: Sets the AWS region used when AWS_REGION is unset (default us-east-1).

name: AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED
what: When set to anything other than false, the bundled AWS SDK does not query the EC2 instance metadata service.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL
what: Sets the endpoint used for AWS STS calls when AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_STS is unset.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK
what: Names the Bedrock endpoint for the client's provider check. A value that points outside Bedrock's own hosts, or is not a URL, is flagged there.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME
what: Names the Bedrock runtime endpoint for the client's provider check. A value that points outside Bedrock's own hosts, or is not a URL, is flagged there.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_STS
what: Overrides the AWS STS endpoint.

name: AWS_EXECUTION_ENV
what: Holds the AWS runtime marker that the client uses to detect Fargate or ECS as the deployment environment.

name: AWS_LAMBDA_BENCHMARK_MODE
what: When 1, the bundled AWS Lambda helper exposes a test reset hook.

name: AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as AWS Lambda.

name: AWS_LAMBDA_NODEJS_NO_GLOBAL_AWSLAMBDA
what: When true or 1, the bundled AWS Lambda helper does not create the global awslambda object.

name: AWS_LOGIN_CACHE_DIRECTORY
what: Sets the directory where the bundled AWS SDK caches login session tokens (default ~/.aws/login/cache).

name: AWS_PROFILE
what: Sets the AWS profile used to resolve credentials and region.

name: AWS_REGION
what: Sets the AWS region for Bedrock and other AWS-backed providers.

name: AWS_ROLE_ARN
what: Sets the IAM role assumed with a web identity token by the AWS credential chain.

name: AWS_ROLE_SESSION_NAME
what: Sets the session name used when the bundled AWS SDK assumes a role with a web identity token.

name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
what: Sets the AWS secret access key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
what: Sets the AWS session token paired with the access key pair.

name: AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE
what: Sets the path of the AWS shared credentials file.

name: AWS_USE_FIPS_ENDPOINT
what: When true, AWS STS calls go to the FIPS endpoint.

name: AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
what: Sets the path of the web identity token the AWS credential chain exchanges for role credentials.

name: AZURE_ADDITIONALLY_ALLOWED_TENANTS
what: Sets the extra Azure tenants, separated by semicolons, that the bundled Azure identity library may request tokens for.

name: AZURE_AUTHORITY_HOST
what: Sets the Azure authority host used by the bundled Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
what: Sets the password of the Azure client certificate used for Foundry authentication through the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH
what: Sets the path of the Azure client certificate used for Foundry authentication through the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
what: Sets the Azure application client id used by the Azure identity library for Foundry authentication.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
what: Sets the Azure client secret used by the Azure identity library for Foundry authentication.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_SEND_CERTIFICATE_CHAIN
what: When true or 1, the Azure identity library sends the certificate chain with certificate authentication.

name: AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE
what: Sets the path of the federated token file for Azure workload identity.

name: AZURE_FUNCTIONS_ENVIRONMENT
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as Azure Functions.

name: AZURE_IDENTITY_DISABLE_MULTITENANTAUTH
what: When set, the Azure identity library always uses the configured tenant instead of a request's tenant.

name: AZURE_LOG_LEVEL
what: Sets the log level of the bundled Azure SDK logger.

name: AZURE_PASSWORD
what: Sets the password for Azure username and password authentication in the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_POD_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY_HOST
what: Sets the endpoint of the Azure pod identity service used for managed identity tokens.

name: AZURE_REGIONAL_AUTHORITY_NAME
what: Sets the Azure region used for regional token authority by the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
what: Sets the Azure tenant id used by the Azure identity library for Foundry authentication.

name: AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS
what: Selects which credential group (dev or prod) the Azure default credential chain tries.

name: AZURE_USERNAME
what: Sets the username for Azure username and password authentication in the Azure identity library.

name: BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the default timeout for Bash commands in milliseconds (default 120000).

name: BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH
what: Sets the maximum characters of Bash tool output kept before truncation, when the bashOutputMaxChars setting is unset.

name: BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the longest timeout a Bash command may request, in milliseconds (default 600000, never below the default timeout).

name: BETA_TRACING_ENDPOINT
what: Sets the endpoint for detailed beta tracing. That tracing is on only when ENABLE_BETA_TRACING_DETAILED is also set.

name: BROWSER
what: Names the preferred browser command. It is recorded in the terminal capability report and restored after the client changes it for a moment.

name: BUF_BIGINT_DISABLE
what: When 1, the bundled protobuf library does not use BigInt for 64-bit integers.

name: BUGHUNTER_DEV_BUNDLE_B64
what: Supplies a development bundle that is forwarded to the remote bug-hunter job.

name: BUGHUNTER_FLEET_SIZE
what: By its name, it sets the size of a bug-hunter fleet. In a remote session, setting it fails a check that otherwise passes for some entrypoints.

name: BUILDKITE
what: Its presence marks the environment as Buildkite CI.

name: BUN_CHROME_PATH
what: Sets the path of the Chrome binary used for artifact previews, replacing the automatic search.

name: BUN_INSTALL
what: Gives the Bun install root. The client uses it to recognise a global Bun installation of Claude Code.

name: C9_PID
what: Its presence marks the environment as AWS Cloud9.

name: C9_USER
what: Its presence marks the environment as AWS Cloud9.

name: CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO
what: Sets the CA bundle path for Cargo. When the client supplies its own CA bundle, it sets this in sandboxed subprocess environments.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_CA_CERT_B64
what: Supplies the CA certificate of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once at proxy setup and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_ENABLED
what: Turns on the agent proxy in a remote session.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_FRAME_HOSTS
what: Lists the hosts whose traffic the remote-session agent proxy frames.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_INCLUDE_HOSTS
what: Lists the hosts routed through the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_NO_PROXY_LOCAL_ONLY
what: Restricts the remote-session agent proxy's no-proxy list to local addresses. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_RECEIVE_GATE_DISABLED
what: Disables the receive gate of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_RELAY_MODE
what: Sets the relay mode of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_UPLOAD_GATE_DISABLED
what: Disables the upload gate of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_ENABLE_BUNDLE
what: Forces repository bundle seeding on for remote sessions, bypassing the server-side gate.

name: CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE
what: Forces repository bundle seeding on for remote sessions, bypassing the server-side gate.

name: CCR_ON_BRANCH_DEFAULT_GUARD
what: Sets the mode of the guard against working on a repository's default branch in remote sessions (enforce, observe or off).

name: CCR_SESSION_PROFILE
what: When set, inline tools are turned off for a remote session profile.

name: CCR_SHR_SSE_HINTS
what: Turns on server-sent-event hints for the self-hosted runner.

name: CCR_SPAWN_TIMESTAMP_MS
what: Holds the spawn time of a remote session process, which the client uses to measure startup latency.

name: CDPATH
what: While it is set for the shells the client starts, a cd to a bare relative directory loses a shortcut in the Bash permission check. The client also clears it in its own cd commands.

name: CF_PAGES
what: When truthy, marks the deployment environment as Cloudflare Pages.

name: CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL
what: Sets the polling interval of the bundled file watcher.

name: CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING
what: Forces the bundled file watcher to poll (true or 1) or not to poll (false or 0).

name: CI
what: When set, the bundled hyperlink-support check treats the terminal as not supporting hyperlinks.

name: CIRCLECI
what: Its presence marks the environment as CircleCI.

name: CLAUBBIT
what: Marks the process as running under Anthropic's internal Claubbit harness. The mark is recorded in telemetry and alters some behaviour.

name: CLAUDECODE
what: Claude Code sets this in the shells it starts. Its presence tells a nested process that it runs inside Claude Code.

name: CLAUDE_AFK_COUNTDOWN_MS
what: Sets how long before the away timeout the countdown is shown, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the away timeout in milliseconds after which the idle prompt acts on its own.

name: CLAUDE_AFTER_LAST_COMPACT
what: When truthy, transcript fetches for a remote session request only the messages after the last compaction.

name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_AUTO_RELAUNCHED_AT
what: Holds the time of the agents view's last automatic relaunch. The view uses it to avoid relaunching again too soon.

name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_SELECT
what: Carries a handoff value set before the agents view relaunches the client. Its presence selects that view on start.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP
what: Sets the client application name added to the User-Agent as client-app/<value>.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS
what: In SDK sessions, turns off the built-in subagent types.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_MCP_MANIFESTS
what: Stops the SDK from capturing MCP server manifests.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_NO_PREFIX
what: Keeps the bare names of tools from SDK-provided MCP servers, without the mcp__ prefix.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION
what: Gives the version of the Agent SDK hosting the client, which the SDK sets when it spawns the client. The client adds it to the User-Agent.

name: CLAUDE_ARTIFACT_HOST_GRANT
what: Sets the host grant used when publishing artifacts, naming which host servers an artifact may use.

name: CLAUDE_ASYNC_AGENT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the stall timeout for background agents in milliseconds, replacing the timeout derived from the stream watchdog.

name: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE
what: Sets the percentage of the context window at which automatic compaction triggers, replacing the built-in threshold.

name: CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS
what: Turns on scheduled worker check-ins for background tasks outside coordinator mode.

name: CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS
what: Sets the screen-reader mode pre-park delay in milliseconds (capped at 5000).

name: CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER
what: Turns screen-reader support on or off, with the --ax-screen-reader flag taking precedence and the axScreenReader setting used when it is unset.

name: CLAUDE_AX_STARTUP_QUIET_MS
what: Sets the length of the screen-reader quiet period after startup in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR
what: When truthy, the Bash tool returns to the project directory after each command.

name: CLAUDE_BG_AUTH_SNAPSHOT_PATH
what: Gives the path of an authentication snapshot that a background session's launcher hands over. The session consumes and removes it at startup.

name: CLAUDE_BG_AUTO_MEMORY_OFF
what: A background session's launcher sets this handoff flag, part of the background-session environment, to say auto memory was off.

name: CLAUDE_BG_BACKEND
what: Names the backend hosting a background session. The value "daemon" marks a daemon-hosted session.

name: CLAUDE_BG_CLAIM_AUTH
what: Hands a claim credential to a pre-started spare background session. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_DISPATCHER_RATE_LIMIT_TIER
what: Carries the rate-limit tier of the dispatcher that launched a background session, for that session's reports.

name: CLAUDE_BG_DISPATCHER_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE
what: Carries the subscription type of the dispatcher that launched a background session, for that session's reports.

name: CLAUDE_BG_ISOLATION
what: Sets the isolation mode of a background session, "worktree" or "none", as its launcher passes it. Without it, the worktree.bgIsolation setting decides.

name: CLAUDE_BG_MEMORY_TOGGLED_OFF
what: When 1 in a background session, auto memory starts switched off, carrying over the launcher's toggle.

name: CLAUDE_BG_POST_CLEAR_RESPAWN
what: Marks a background session respawned after /clear. Start-up then treats it as a fresh conversation instead of a resume.

name: CLAUDE_BG_PTY_AUTH
what: Supplies the credential for the background session's terminal host. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_RENDEZVOUS_SOCK
what: Names the socket a background session uses to meet its launcher. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_RV_AUTH
what: Supplies the credential for the background-session rendezvous socket. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_SESSION_PERMISSION_RULES
what: Hands a background session the JSON allow and deny permission rules from its launcher.

name: CLAUDE_BG_SOCKET_TOKENS_PATH
what: Gives the path of a file holding background-session socket credentials. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_SOURCE
what: Says how a background session was started. The value "spare" marks a pre-started spare process.

name: CLAUDE_BG_STARTUP_WEDGE_MS
what: Sets the time after which a background session that has not finished starting is treated as wedged (default 45000 ms).

name: CLAUDE_BG_TCC_DISCLAIMED
what: The client sets this before it re-executes itself on macOS to disclaim privacy-permission ownership. On the second start it is removed and the step is skipped.

name: CLAUDE_BG_WORKSPACE_TRUSTED
what: Tells a background or reattached session that its launcher had already trusted the workspace.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the base URL of the Remote Control bridge service. It is one of the variables that must match the stored login before the bridge inbox is fetched.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_GROUPING
what: Hands a grouping key to a process reattaching to a Remote Control session. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_NO_BACKFILL
what: Tells a process reattaching to a Remote Control session not to backfill history. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_OUTBOUND_ONLY
what: Tells a process reattaching to a Remote Control session to send events without accepting inbound control.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_OWNER_ACCT
what: Names the owner account of the Remote Control session being reattached. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_OWNER_ORG
what: Names the owner organization of the Remote Control session being reattached. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_SEQ
what: Gives the sequence number from which a reattaching process resumes a Remote Control session. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_REATTACH_SESSION
what: Names the Remote Control session a newly started process reattaches to and turns the bridge on for that process.

name: CLAUDE_BYTE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the idle timeout in milliseconds for the byte-level stream watchdog, replacing the server-side default.

name: CLAUDE_CHROME_CLASSIFIER_FLOOR
what: Turns the auto-mode classifier floor for the Chrome tools on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CHROME_PAIRED_DEVICE_ID
what: Sets the browser extension device id the Chrome integration pairs with. A value that is not a valid device id is ignored.

name: CLAUDE_CHROME_PERMISSION_MODE
what: Sets the permission mode for the Chrome integration's bridge. An invalid value is ignored with a warning.

name: CLAUDE_CHROME_TAB_GROUP_KEY
what: Hands a Chrome tab group key to a remote session. The client reads it at startup and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE
what: Gives the path of a marker file whose existence tells the session that a client app is present.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_3P_PROBE_WROTE_HAIKU_DEFAULT
what: Records the Haiku model id the client itself chose for a third-party provider. A later probe uses it to tell the client's choice from the user's.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_3P_PROBE_WROTE_OPUS_DEFAULT
what: Records the Opus model id the client itself chose for a third-party provider. A later probe uses it to tell the client's choice from the user's.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_3P_PROBE_WROTE_SONNET_DEFAULT
what: Records the Sonnet model id the client itself chose for a third-party provider. A later probe uses it to tell the client's choice from the user's.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_3P_SEEDED_OPUS_DEFAULT
what: Records the Opus model id the client seeded for a third-party provider, to recognise its own default later.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_3P_SEEDED_SONNET_DEFAULT
what: Records the Sonnet model id the client seeded for a third-party provider, to recognise its own default later.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY
what: When set, the terminal UI keeps the cursor visible on resume, as it does for a screen reader. Going by the name, it is a wider accessibility mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_TAGGED_ID
what: Sets the account id reported as user.account_id in telemetry, replacing the one derived from the account uuid.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID
what: Sets the account uuid used for telemetry and attribution when the login does not provide one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ACTION
what: When truthy, the entrypoint is recorded as the Claude Code GitHub Action.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ACT_DONT_REDERIVE
what: Turns on or off a system-prompt instruction about not re-deriving facts before acting. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD
what: When truthy, CLAUDE.md files in directories added with --add-dir are loaded too.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_PROTECTION
what: Sends the header x-anthropic-additional-protection with the value true on API requests.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ADOPT_UNDERIVABLE_PARKED_PERMISSION
what: Hands a respawned session a resume option about adopting a parked permission prompt whose origin cannot be derived.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT
what: Sets the agent name for the session, which is recorded in the session registry. The client sets it from --agent.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_PROXY_GH_SHIM
what: In a remote session behind the agent proxy, writes a shim so the gh command goes through the proxy.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_PROXY_GIT_CONFIG
what: In a remote session behind the agent proxy, appends git configuration that routes git through the proxy.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_PROXY_GIT_HOSTS
what: Lists the git hosts, separated by commas, that the agent proxy governs.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_VIEW_RELAUNCH
what: The client sets this before the agents view relaunches it. It is read once at start and then removed.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ALTGR_AS_TEXT
what: A truthy value forces AltGr key combinations to be read as text and a falsy value turns that off, with Windows Terminal deciding when it is unset.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ALT_SCREEN_FULL_REPAINT
what: Repaints the whole alternate screen on every frame instead of only the changes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT
what: Treats the effort parameter as supported for any model that is not on the known-unsupported list.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AMBER_ASTROLABE
what: Forces on a model-specific behaviour the client names "amber_astrolabe". When it is unset, the model's own configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_API_BASE_URL
what: Sets an alternate API base URL that is considered when the client checks which variable sets the endpoint in use.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_FILE_DESCRIPTOR
what: Sets the file descriptor from which the API key is read at startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS
what: Sets how long a value from the apiKeyHelper script is cached, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_APPEND_PROMPT_HEAD
what: Sets the expected head of the appended system prompt, checked at startup and recorded in telemetry.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT
what: A falsy value turns the Artifact tool off and a truthy value turns it on for SDK sessions, where it is off by default.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACTS_API_TOKEN
what: Sets the bearer token for the artifacts API on the frame host, replacing the session's own credentials.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_ASSETS
what: Turns artifact asset uploads on or off. When it is unset, the client decides from the session type.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_AUTO_OPEN
what: A falsy value stops a newly published artifact from opening automatically.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENTS
what: Turns artifact comments on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENTS_AUTOREACT
what: Turns automatic reactions to artifact comments on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENT_FAST_ACK
what: Turns fast acknowledgement of artifact comments on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENT_FAST_ACK_FIXED
what: Fixes the fast-acknowledgement setting for artifact comments so it is not refreshed from the server.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_COMMENT_RESPONDER
what: Turns the artifact comment responder on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_DB
what: Turns the artifact database on or off (default on).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_DB_STR_REPLACE
what: Turns string replacement in artifact database writes on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_DELETE
what: Turns artifact deletion on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_FRESH_READ
what: A false value turns off the requirement to re-read an artifact before replacing it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_HOT
what: Turns hot updates of published artifacts on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_MULTI_FILE
what: Turns multi-file artifacts on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_OPENING_PREFETCH
what: A false value turns off prefetching artifacts when they are opened.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_OPEN_ACTION
what: Turns the artifact open action on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_PATH_PIN
what: Turns path pinning for artifact files on or off (default on).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_PIN
what: Turns artifact pinning on or off (default on).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_PRESENCE
what: Turns artifact presence (who is viewing) on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_PREVIEW
what: Turns artifact previews on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_QUICKSTART
what: Turns the artifact quickstart action on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_SHARE
what: When true in a desktop or cloud session, it turns on a check that, by its name, enables sharing artifacts.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_START_KIT
what: Turns the artifact start kit on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_TEXT_VARIANT
what: Chooses the artifact tool's instruction text variant (v0, v1 or v2).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_TOOLSET
what: Turns the artifact toolset on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_TYPES
what: Turns artifact types on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_TYPE_CATALOG
what: Turns the artifact type catalog on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_TYPE_CLOUD_CREATE
what: Turns creating artifacts from a type in cloud sessions on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_VERIFY
what: Turns artifact verification reads on or off outside remote sessions. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_ANNOUNCEMENT
what: Turns the attribution announcement on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides (default on).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER
what: A falsy value removes the attribution block the client adds to requests.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTH_FAIL_EXIT_MS
what: Sets how long, 600000 ms by default, a remote child session keeps running after authentication stops recovering. A value of 0 means it never exits.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the time after which a main-agent Bash command moves to the background, if lower than the requested timeout.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW
what: Sets the context window size used to compute the automatic compaction threshold.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_CONNECT_IDE
what: A false value stops the client from connecting to an IDE automatically and a true value forces it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER
what: Holds the user's own switch for the server-side auto-mode classifier, which by its name turns that classifier on or off. The client passes it to the sessions it starts.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_TIER
what: When set, the auto-mode classifier runs at the strict tier.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AWS_CHAIN_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for resolving the AWS credential chain, in milliseconds (default 60000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BASALT_COVE
what: Forces on a model-specific behaviour the client names "basalt_cove". When it is unset, the model's configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BASE_REF
what: Sets the Git base ref used for diffs when no per-repository base ref is configured.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BASE_REFS
what: Supplies base refs for the repository checkouts the client tracks. By the name, these are the git refs that diffs are taken against.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BASH_EDIT_DIFF
what: Turns diffs for files edited through Bash on or off, ahead of the bashEditDiffEnabled setting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BASH_OUTPUT_AUDIENCE_NOTE
what: Turns on or off a note in Bash tool output about who reads it. When it is unset, the model's configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BASH_SANDBOX_SHOW_INDICATOR
what: Shows sandboxed Bash calls under the name SandboxedBash instead of Bash.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BENCH_LIVE_COUNTS
what: Turns on live render counters in the terminal UI for benchmarking.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING
what: False turns off a default-on check on running background tasks. True turns on a second check, which by the name makes the report of running tasks stricter.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BISON_CAIRN
what: Turns on or off a model-specific behaviour the client names "bison_cairn". When it is unset, the model's configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BLOCKING_LIMIT_OVERRIDE
what: Overrides the context limit at which the client blocks further input until compaction.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BREEZY_HORIZON
what: Replaces, for a given model, a value the client otherwise takes from client data, apparently the name of another model to use. A falsy value turns it off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_CHILD_ARTIFACT
what: Set by a Remote Control host for its child process to turn the Artifact tool on there.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_CHILD_AUTO_DEFAULT
what: Set by a Remote Control host for its child process to mark the bridge as on by default.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_CHILD_MACHINE_SETTINGS
what: Set by a Remote Control host for its child process to say the child should use the machine's settings.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_MCP_CARRIER
what: Marks a process as the MCP carrier child of a Remote Control bridge. The client sets it to "spent" once it is used.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_OWNER_ACCOUNT_UUID
what: Gives the account uuid of the owner of a Remote Control session, used when the process runs as a bridge.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_OWNER_ORG_UUID
what: Gives the organization uuid of the owner of a Remote Control session, used when the process runs as a bridge.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_PROMPT_SHA256
what: Gives the hash of the prompt a Remote Control bridge child should run. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIEF
what: Turns on brief mode. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BRIEF_UPLOAD
what: Selects the brief-upload mode for the session when the REPL bridge is off. By the name, briefs from this session are then uploaded.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BS_AS_CTRL_BACKSPACE
what: A truthy value treats Backspace as Ctrl+Backspace and a falsy value turns that off, with the platform and terminal deciding when it is unset.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BUBBLEWRAP
what: Tells environment detection that the process runs, by the name, inside a bubblewrap sandbox. With it set, a root user may still use --dangerously-skip-permissions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_BYOC_ENABLE_DATADOG
what: In bring-your-own-compute environments, turns Datadog reporting back on.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CCR_EARLY_HYDRATE_PREFETCH
what: In a resumed remote session, starts fetching the transcript early during startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CCR_EARLY_PLUGINS_SYNC
what: In a non-interactive remote session, starts the plugin sync early during startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CCR_EARLY_REMOTE_CONNECT
what: In a resumed remote session, connects to the remote early during startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CCR_EARLY_SKILLS_SYNC
what: In a non-interactive remote session, starts the skills sync early during startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CCR_FOLD_FIRST_TURN_RESCAN
what: In a remote session, folds the first turn's plugin rescan into startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CCR_SKIP_FRESH_MIGRATIONS
what: In a fresh remote session, skips the settings migrations and records them as done.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CCR_SURFACE
what: Names the remote-session surface. The value "tag" adds the Claude tag plugin marketplace to plugin requests.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE
what: Chooses which certificate stores to trust (bundled, system or both) as a comma-separated list.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION
what: Marks the process as a child session for the client's state and its session-persistence checks. By the name, another Claude Code process started it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CHROME_MCP_ORG_DENIED
what: Tells a child process that the parent's organization policy denies the Chrome integration.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLASSIFIER_SUMMARY
what: Where a classifier surface asks for a summary, true picks an LLM summary and false a heuristic one. Unset, the tengu_classifier_summary_llm_emit gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT
what: Sets the path of the client certificate used for mutual TLS.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_DATA_URL
what: Sets the URL the client fetches client data from, which must be https and carry no credentials. The client also sets it itself from the bootstrap response.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY
what: Sets the path of the private key for the mutual TLS client certificate.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY_PASSPHRASE
what: Sets the passphrase for the mutual TLS client key.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_COLD_COMPACT
what: By its name, it turns on a cold form of compaction. The function that reads it sits beside the automatic compaction code.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CONFIG_PROBE
what: Marks the process as the IDE's configuration probe, in which the client skips its AWS credential refresh.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CONTAINER_ID
what: Gives the id of the hosting container. When the client runs as root inside it, a temp directory owned by another user is tolerated with a warning.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_EXTRA_TOOLS
what: Lists extra tool names, separated by commas, that a coordinator session keeps.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_FORCE_WORKER_INHERIT_MODEL
what: Makes coordinator workers always use the session's model and tells the model to omit the model parameter.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_MODE
what: When truthy, the session runs in coordinator mode. The client also sets it when the mode is switched.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_SKILL_GUIDANCE
what: Going by the name and the coordinator code around it, it adds guidance about skills to the coordinator's instructions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_COWORK_FRAME_ARTIFACTS
what: Recorded in the client's state at startup. By its name, it tells the client that the Cowork app shows artifacts in frames.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_COZY_TEAPOT
what: Chooses the strict or relaxed variant of the Bash act-first steering text. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_CUSTOM_OAUTH_URL
what: Sets a custom OAuth service URL and also switches the global config file to the -custom-oauth suffix.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DAEMON_COLD_START
what: Sets how the daemon behaves on a cold start ("transient" or "ask"). Otherwise the daemonColdStart setting or a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DATADOG_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS
what: Sets the flush interval for Datadog event batches in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DD_ERROR_TRACKING_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS
what: Sets the flush interval for Datadog error-tracking batches in milliseconds (default 30000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOGS_DIR
what: Sets the directory for debug log files, one file per session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOG_LEVEL
what: Sets the minimum level written to the debug log (default debug).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_REPAINTS
what: Highlights terminal repaints for debugging the renderer.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DECSTBM
what: When truthy, the client uses the scroll-region (DECSTBM) terminal renderer. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DESIGN_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
what: Sets the OAuth client id for the design integration, replacing the built-in one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DESKTOP_APP_VERSION
what: Gives the version of the Claude desktop app hosting the client. It is reported when the entrypoint is the desktop app or the local agent.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DIAGNOSTICS_FILE
what: Sets the path of a file to which structured diagnostic events are written.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT
what: Turns off 1M-token context windows and treats model ids with [1m] as standard.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING
what: Uses fixed instead of adaptive thinking for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 models.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADMIN_ENV_UNION
what: Takes managed-settings environment variables from the highest admin tier only, instead of merging all tiers.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL
what: Turns off the advisor tool.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW
what: Turns off the agents view.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN
what: Keeps the terminal UI out of the alternate screen buffer.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT
what: Turns off the Artifact tool and is checked before the enableArtifact and disableArtifact settings.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS
what: Turns off attachments, including deferred tool attachments.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTH_REFRESH_LOCK
what: Turns off the file lock that serialises credential refreshes across processes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY
what: A truthy value turns auto memory off and a falsy value forces it on.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AWAITING_USER_IDLE
what: Stops the session from reporting itself idle while it waits on the user.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS
what: Turns off background tasks.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BEDROCK_CONTENT_TYPE_DEFAULT
what: Stops the client from adding the event-stream content type to Bedrock responses that lack one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BEDROCK_CONTENT_TYPE_GUARD
what: Stops the client from rejecting Bedrock streaming responses with an unexpected content type.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_EXIT_HANDOFF
what: Turns off handing running work to a background session when the client exits.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP
what: Turns off killing background shells under resource pressure.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
what: Turns off the skills bundled with Claude Code.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CFC_PROMPT
what: Removes the Chrome integration's system prompt.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_API_SKILL
what: Turns off the bundled Claude API skill.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL
what: Turns off the bundled Claude Code skill.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS
what: Stops CLAUDE.md files from loading. The client sets it itself in safe mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON
what: Turns off the cron scheduling tools.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT
what: Turns off the timeout on dangerous rm confirmations.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS
what: Stops the client from sending experimental API beta headers.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_INHERIT_CAP
what: Lets the built-in Explore agent inherit the session model without the Opus cap.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS
what: Turns off the built-in Explore and Plan agents.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE
what: Turns off fast mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY
what: Turns off feedback surveys.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
what: Turns off file checkpointing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS
what: Removes the built-in git instructions from the system prompt. When it is unset, the includeGitInstructions setting decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_HOOK_FORWARDING
what: Serves as the off switch of the check that admits forwarded hooks over the SDK connection. Going by the name, it stops hook forwarding to remote sessions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LEGACY_MODEL_REMAP
what: Stops the client from remapping legacy model ids to current ones.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND
what: Stops MCP tasks from moving to the background.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_BULK_INFLATE
what: Turns off bulk download of the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_MASS_DELETE_HOLD
what: Turns off the safety hold on mass deletions in the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_PERIODIC_RESYNC
what: Turns off periodic resync of the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_RO_UNSAVED_NOTICE
what: Turns off the notice about unsaved changes in a read-only memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_STREAM_LIST
what: Turns off streamed listing of the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MODEL_ACCESS_FALLBACK
what: Turns off falling back to another model when the configured one is not available to the account.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE
what: A truthy value turns mouse support off and a falsy value forces full mouse support.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS
what: A truthy value keeps scrolling but turns off mouse clicks.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MTLS_RELOAD_ON_STALE_CONNECTION
what: Stops the client from reloading the mutual TLS certificate after a stale connection.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_CHAIN_IDLE
what: When set, a blocked nested prompt chain is not counted toward the session waiting on the user. The name suggests this keeps such chains from idling the session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_USER_REPAIR
what: Turns off repairing malformed nested user messages from SDK input.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
what: Turns off non-essential network traffic, including telemetry and feature-flag fetching.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK
what: Turns off retrying a failed streaming request as a non-streaming one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NOTIFICATION_PRESENCE_CHECK
what: Sends notifications even when the user appears to be present.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE_AUTOINSTALL
what: Turns off automatic installation of the official plugin marketplace.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ORG_MEMORY
what: Turns off organization memory.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PERMISSION_PROMPT_NOTIFY_HOOKS
what: Turns off the notification hooks fired when a permission prompt waits.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PLUGIN_FORWARDING
what: Turns off forwarding this machine's plugins to cloud sessions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POLICY_SKILLS
what: Skips skills from managed policy settings.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POWERSHELL_CMD_RM_DENY
what: Turns off denying cmd-style recursive deletes in PowerShell.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PRECOMPACT_SKIP
what: By its name, it turns off a step that skips work before compaction. The client parses it while loading a session's stored entries.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK
what: Turns off switching to a fallback model after a refusal.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_RETRY
what: Turns off retrying after a refusal.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STARTUP_WORK_GATE
what: Stops the client from arming its startup work gate. Going by the name and the hold and release calls beside it, that gate defers work until startup finishes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SUBSTITUTION_RM_PROMPT
what: Turns off the prompt for rm commands whose target comes from a command substitution.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE
what: Stops the client from setting the terminal title.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING
what: Turns off extended thinking.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TURN_HANDOFF
what: Serves as the off switch of the check that admits turn handoff for a remote session. By the name, it stops turns passing between that session and this client.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT
what: Stops the client from enforcing the default context window for unrecognised models.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_VIRTUAL_SCROLL
what: Turns off virtual scrolling in the transcript.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_VITALS_EMITTER
what: Turns off the guest vitals emitter.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH
what: Turns off the WebFetch tool.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WINDOWS_SHELL_LAUNCHER
what: Turns off the Windows shell launcher.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS
what: Turns off workflows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKING_SYNC
what: In a remote session, turns off syncing working files.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DONT_INHERIT_ENV
what: Starts the shell snapshot without the user's environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DOWNLOAD_DEADLINE_MS_FOR_TESTING
what: Sets the download deadline for updates, for testing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EAGER_FLUSH
what: Flushes the transcript to disk after every write.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EDITOR_CODELIVERY
what: With it set, a relayed human message can carry an artifact follow-up acknowledgement with an https URL. By the name, the editor then delivers that follow-up too.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL
what: Sets the effort level for the session. Unset and "auto" both mean no override.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ELEGANT_MEADOW
what: Forces the value of the tengu_elegant_meadow gate either way, with the gate deciding when it is unset. What that gate controls cannot be told from its name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_SESSION_STATE_EVENTS
what: Emits session_state_changed system events on the SDK output stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_STARTUP_TIMING
what: Emits startup timing phases outside remote sessions too.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_TOOL_USE_SUMMARIES
what: Fills the emitToolUseSummaries setting of the session's query config. By the name, it makes the client emit summaries of tool use, likely on the SDK stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_APPEND_SUBAGENT_PROMPT
what: Lets the SDK option appendSubagentSystemPrompt add text to subagent system prompts. The SDK sets it when that option is used.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY
what: Forces the away summary on (truthy) or off (falsy). Otherwise the awaySummaryEnabled setting decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_BACKGROUND_PLUGIN_REFRESH
what: Refreshes plugins in the background after startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_CFC
what: Turns the Claude in Chrome integration on or off by default. Flags and settings can still decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_ADVISOR_TOOL
what: Forces the experimental advisor tool on where it is available. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL
what: Keeps feedback surveys on when telemetry is otherwise off for OpenTelemetry users.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING
what: A false value turns off fine-grained tool input streaming. Otherwise the provider and a server-side gate decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY
what: Discovers available models from a non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateway.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_MENU_KIND_LANES
what: Turns on lanes in the slash-command menu, as the tengu_mint_lanes gate does when the variable is unset. By the name, the lanes group commands by kind.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION
what: Turns prompt suggestions on or off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER
what: Turns on the proxy authentication helper configured in settings.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_REFRESH_MCP_TOOLS
what: Adds the RefreshMcpTools tool to the tools the model can call. That tool asks connected MCP servers for their current tool lists again.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_REMOTE_RECAP
what: Turns the recap for remote sessions on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
what: Turns on file checkpointing in SDK sessions. The SDK sets it from its checkpointing option.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS
what: A false value turns off the task tools.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY
what: Turns on OpenTelemetry export of metrics and events.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS
what: Turns on the todo tools where the default would leave them off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TOKEN_USAGE_ATTACHMENT
what: Attaches token usage (used, total, remaining) to the model's context.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_XAA
what: Turns on cross-app access (XAA) for MCP authentication.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA
what: Turns on the enhanced telemetry beta (turn trace contexts), the same as ENABLE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT
what: Names how the client was launched (cli, sdk-ts, claude-vscode, remote and others). The client sets it at startup and branches many behaviours on it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENVIRONMENT_KIND
what: Names the kind of hosting environment, such as byoc for bring-your-own-compute.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENVIRONMENT_RUNNER_VERSION
what: Gives the version of the environment runner, which is sent as the x-environment-runner-version header.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_CONFINED
what: Marks an evaluation child process, in which allow permission rules are dropped.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_INTERVIEW_SESSION
what: Marks an evaluation interview session, in which reports are not published. The client sets it when starting one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_FIRST_RENDER
what: Skips the startup prefetches and the fullscreen crash check. Going by the name, the process exits after the terminal UI first renders, as for timing startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY
what: Exits this many milliseconds after the session stops and stays idle.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS
what: Turns on agent teams, the same as --agent-teams, though a server-side gate can still veto.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_OBSERVER_AGENTS
what: Turns on observer agents, though a server-side gate can still veto.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY
what: Merges a JSON object into API request bodies without overriding system, tools or messages.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_METADATA
what: Adds a JSON object to request metadata.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FEDERATION_CACHE_DIR
what: Sets the directory for the workload identity federation token cache.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
what: Sets the maximum tokens the Read tool returns from one file.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FLAG_FETCH_WAIT_MS
what: Sets how long startup waits for feature flags after a relaunch, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FLEETVIEW_SIMPLE
what: Uses the simple fleet view. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FOOTER_INDICATOR
what: Sets the text of the footer indicator, ahead of the value from client data.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_FULLSCREEN_UPSELL
what: Forces the fullscreen-mode upsell to show.
