name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_MID_CONVERSATION_SYSTEM
what: Forces mid-conversation system messages for tool changes on models that support them.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SESSION_PERSISTENCE
what: Overrides the check that would turn session persistence off in a child session. By the name, it keeps persistence on there.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_STRIKETHROUGH
what: Treats the terminal as supporting strikethrough text.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT
what: Treats the terminal as supporting synchronized output.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES
what: Treats the terminal as supporting inline images.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TIP_ID
what: Names, by id, the spinner tip to show when USER_TYPE marks an internal user. It works only while the tengu_tips_mod gate turns the spinner-tips plugin on.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_WINDOWS_CREDMAN
what: When 1, stores credentials in the Windows Credential Manager regardless of the server-side gate.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT
what: Turns forked subagents on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT
what: Forwards subagent text on the SDK output stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_USER_INTENT
what: Going by the name and the message-attribution code beside it, it forwards the user's intent with relayed messages.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FRAME_TIMING_LOG
what: Sets the path of a file to which terminal frame timings are appended.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FRAME_TIMING_SAMPLE_EVERY
what: Logs every Nth frame timing to the frame timing log.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS
what: Turns gateway hint headers on or off. Otherwise the provider and a server-side gate decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for gateway model discovery in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR
what: Gives a file descriptor from which a gateway token is read at startup. The client removes it from the environment after use.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GB_DISK_CACHE_WHEN_TELEMETRY_OFF
what: With telemetry off, lets feature-flag reads answer from the cached values in the global config file.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GENTLE_PARASOL
what: Overrides the per-model text of an ephemeral reminder that otherwise comes from client data.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH
what: Sets the path of the Git Bash executable on Windows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_HIDDEN
what: Sets whether file search includes hidden files (default true).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_NO_IGNORE
what: Sets whether file search ignores .gitignore rules (default true).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
what: Sets the timeout for file search in seconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES
what: Sets the interval between goal check-ins in minutes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GORSE_PLOVER
what: Forces on the Bash act-first behaviour. Otherwise client data or a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GROWTHBOOK_KICK_FROM_INIT
what: By the name and the startup code, it starts the feature-flag fetch during initialisation. Startup telemetry records it as kick_from_init.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_CCR_REQUEST_BODIES
what: Turns gzip compression of remote-worker request bodies on or off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES
what: Turns gzip compression of API request bodies on or off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODY_BLOCKS
what: Chooses the gzip block mode for request bodies (0, 1 or 2). Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODY_LEVEL
what: Sets the gzip compression level for request bodies (1 to 9). Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HARBOR_KITE
what: Forces harbor kite on or off, which the strings near it describe as cross-session messaging. Unset, tengu_harbor_kite decides, with tengu_harbor_kite_win able to veto it on Windows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HARBOR_KITE_CLOUD
what: By the name, it extends harbor kite to cloud sessions, through a check that also needs remote sessions allowed. Unset, the tengu_harbor_kite_cloud gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HARBOR_KITE_PACING_OFF
what: Turns off pacing of outbound harbor kite messages.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD
what: Hides the working directory in the startup header.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_SETTINGS_HINT
what: When truthy, hides the settings hint.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOLD_REPORT_PARK_AT_INIT
what: Holds the report that a resumed interrupted turn is parked until initialisation finishes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOME_SEED_HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the maximum hold while the home directory is being seeded, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOME_SEED_VERDICT_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the maximum wait for the home seeding verdict, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOOKS_SAME_THREAD
what: Runs function hooks on the main thread instead of a worker. The client sets it itself during hook registration.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_ENV_VAR
what: Names the environment variable that carries a host-provided auth token.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for asking the SDK host to refresh its auth token, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_CREDS_FILE
what: Gives the path of a host-provided credentials file, used together with the gateway lineage marker.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_GATEWAY_LINEAGE
what: Marks a process started by a gateway host. The client sets it for its children.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_PLATFORM
what: Overrides the detected platform (win32, darwin or linux).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_PROMPT_SUPERSEDES_RECORD
what: Read when a print-mode session starts and passed on to child processes. By the name, the host's prompt then replaces the one recorded in the session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SCHEDULED_RUN
what: Recorded in the client's state at startup. Going by the name, it marks a run that the host scheduled.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SESSION_ID
what: In a session hosted by the desktop app, the client reads it next to its session-naming code. By the name, it carries the session id that host assigned.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOVER_REST
what: When its value parses as "pinned", the client apparently ties its storage to the config folder named at startup. Unset, the tengu_hover_rest gate supplies the value.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTPS_PROXY
what: Sets the HTTPS proxy used for sandboxed commands when HTTPS_PROXY and https_proxy are unset.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTP_PROXY
what: Sets the HTTP proxy used for sandboxed commands when HTTP_PROXY and http_proxy are unset.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HUMBLE_HAMMOCK
what: Forces the tengu_humble_hammock behaviour either way, with another check or the gate deciding when it is unset. Its purpose cannot be told from the name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_HOST_OVERRIDE
what: Sets the host address used to reach the IDE, instead of 127.0.0.1 or the WSL default route.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL
what: Stops automatic installation of the IDE extension.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_VALID_CHECK
what: Skips checking that an IDE's workspace contains the working directory.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
what: Sets the idle minutes after which the idle-session action runs (default 75).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_TOKEN_THRESHOLD
what: Sets the minimum context tokens before the idle-session action applies (default 100000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_INCLUDE_PARTIAL_MESSAGES
what: Includes partial streaming messages on the SDK output stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_INLINE_TOOLS
what: Turns inline tools on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_INTRO_FRAME
what: Turns on or off an introductory framing in the system prompt. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IS_COWORK
what: Marks the process, by its name, as running inside the Cowork app. Several checks then treat it as they treat a remote session, synced skills among them.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_JUNIPER_SUNDIAL
what: Sets the number of turns between maintenance passes, 10 by default. When it is unset, client data or the tengu_juniper_sundial gate supplies the number.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_KB_COHESION_FIXES
what: Turns on one check. Going by the name, that check enables a set of "KB cohesion" fixes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LANTERN_PRISM
what: Forces on the tengu_lantern_prism behaviour regardless of the gate. That behaviour cannot be told from the name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LARCH_CISTERN
what: Forces on a model-specific behaviour the client names "larch_cistern". When it is unset, the model's configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LEGACY_BUNDLE
what: Uses the previous git bundle behaviour for this session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE
what: Turns loop keepalive on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_PERSISTENT
what: Uses the persistent autonomous-loop preamble. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS
what: Sets the maximum subagents running at once (default 20).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS
what: Sets the context window in tokens to assume when DISABLE_COMPACT is set.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_EFFORT_REMINDER
what: Turns the maximum-effort reminder on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH
what: Sets the maximum length of an MCP tool description.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
what: Sets the maximum output tokens per response, within the model's limit.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES
what: Sets the maximum API retries, clamped to a ceiling.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH
what: Sets the maximum nesting depth of subagents. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TOOL_USE_CONCURRENCY
what: Sets the maximum concurrency-safe tool calls run at once (default 10).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TURNS
what: Sets the maximum agentic turns, as a positive integer, when --max-turns is not given.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION
what: Sets the maximum web searches per session (default 200).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_ALLOWLIST_ENV
what: Turns the MCP server environment allowlist on (truthy) or off (falsy). By default it is on only for the local agent.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_APPS_HOST
what: When true, the client tells MCP servers it can show MCP apps as HTML. By the name, the host around the client is what renders them.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS
what: Sets the time after which an MCP tool call moves to the background. A value of 0 turns this off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_CONNECTOR_PREWAIT_MS
what: Sets how long an SDK session waits for MCP connectors before the first turn, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_MEMORY_CGROUP
what: A falsy value or none turns off the memory cgroup for MCP servers on Linux.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_PREWAIT_SERVERS
what: Names the MCP servers an SDK session waits for before the first turn.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_PREWAIT_SERVERS_MS
what: Sets how long an SDK session waits for the named MCP servers, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS
what: Sets how long startup waits for MCP servers to connect, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT
what: Sets the idle timeout for MCP tool calls in milliseconds. A value of 0 or less turns it off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_PUSH_DELETE_MODE
what: Sets how deletions are pushed to the memory store ("corroborate", "immediate" or "never"). Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_SUBAGENT_APPEND
what: Stops memory instructions from being appended to subagent system prompts.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET
what: Sets the socket path for cross-session messaging. The client sets it itself when it publishes its own inbox.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CAPABILITIES
what: Overrides capabilities per model, as semicolon-separated entries in model=capabilities form.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG
what: A falsy value turns off fetching the model catalog.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG_URL
what: Sets the URL of the model catalog, replacing the default.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_NANKEEN_KESTREL
what: On Windows, it turns on the tengu_nankeen_kestrel behaviour, which is otherwise left to the gate. The strings beside it suggest the behaviour is the Windows sandbox.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_NATIVE_CURSOR
what: Uses the terminal's native cursor. Otherwise accessibility mode or a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT
what: Uses the new /init flow. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_NONBLOCKING_STDOUT
what: Turns non-blocking stdout writes on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES
what: Sets the number of retries after a non-streaming request times out.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER
what: Turns the flicker-free fullscreen renderer on or off. A false value also keeps the UI out of the alternate screen.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_NO_MODEL_FALLBACK
what: Turns off falling back to another model when the configured one is unavailable.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_401_WAIT_MS
what: Sets how long to wait for refreshed credentials after a 401, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
what: Sets the OAuth client id, replacing the built-in one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
what: Sets the OAuth refresh token used to log in non-interactively. It requires CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES
what: Sets the OAuth scopes requested with the refresh token, separated by spaces.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
what: Sets the OAuth access token used to authenticate.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR
what: Sets the file descriptor from which the OAuth token is read at startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID
what: Sets the organization uuid sent with session-key authentication and used for attribution.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_CONTENT_MAX_LENGTH
what: Sets the maximum length of content attributes in OpenTelemetry records (default 61440).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_DIAG_STDERR
what: Also writes OpenTelemetry diagnostic errors to stderr.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for flushing OpenTelemetry exporters, in milliseconds (default 5000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_HEADERS_HELPER_DEBOUNCE_MS
what: Sets how long OpenTelemetry headers from the headers helper are cached, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for shutting down OpenTelemetry exporters, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_MANAGER_AUTO_UPDATE
what: Lets a package-manager installation (such as Homebrew) update itself automatically.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PARKED_PERMISSION_WAIT_MS
what: Sets how long a resumed session waits for an answer to a parked permission prompt (default 2000 ms).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PARKED_RUN_BEFORE_CLEAR
what: Hands a respawned session a resume option about running parked work before clearing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PARKED_STOP_RETIRES
what: Hands a respawned session a resume option about retiring a parked stop.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PARSED_WILLOW
what: Replaces the value of the tengu_parsed_willow gate, which defaults on, in either direction. Its purpose cannot be told from the name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PERFETTO_TRACE
what: By its name, it turns on Perfetto tracing. The client logs its value when tracing starts up.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE
what: When truthy, treats read-only files as Perforce files that need p4 edit before editing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PEWTER_OWL
what: Turns the "pewter_owl" feature on or off, ahead of the server-side gates whose names the client builds at run time.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PEWTER_OWL_TOOL
what: Turns the "pewter_owl" tool on or off, ahead of its server-side gate.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_MODE_REQUIRED
what: Decides whether a teammate must use plan mode when no team context settles it. By the name, a true value makes plan mode required.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_V2_AGENT_COUNT
what: Sets the number of agents plan mode uses, 1 to 10.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLAN_V2_EXPLORE_AGENT_COUNT
what: Sets the number of explore agents plan mode uses, 1 to 10 (default 3).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_ATTRIBUTION
what: Supplies attribution entries that the client looks up per plugin before any other source. It is also passed into the environment of the processes the client starts.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_BINARY_ASSETS
what: Lets plugins fetch binary assets. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR
what: Sets the directory for the plugin cache.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS
what: Adds extra plugin directories, separated by the platform path separator.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH
what: Turns watching plugin directories for changes on or off (default on outside SDK sessions).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for git operations on plugin marketplaces (default 120000 ms).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE
what: Keeps the existing marketplace clone when its remote cannot be reached.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS
what: Clones plugin marketplaces over HTTPS instead of SSH.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR
what: Adds directories with pre-seeded plugins, separated by the platform path separator.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_USE_ZIP_CACHE
what: Stores the plugin cache as zip files.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_POLISHED_DEWDROP
what: Picks "drop", "block" or "off" in place of the tengu_polished_dewdrop gate's value, under one further check. What is dropped or blocked cannot be told from the name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_POLL_EVENTS
what: By its name, it turns on poll-event delivery, which also needs two other checks to pass.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY
what: Turns on the hosted post-turn memory pass, configured by CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY_CONFIG. Without a valid config the client logs that the pass is off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY_CONFIG
what: Sets the JSON configuration of the post-turn memory instruction.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_POST_TURN_MEMORY_SYNC
what: Runs the post-turn memory instruction after every turn without idle flushing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY
what: Runs PowerShell without -ExecutionPolicy Bypass. The system's execution policy then applies.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_POWERUP_ONBOARDING
what: Shows the power-up onboarding as a banner or a step even after onboarding is complete.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS
what: Sets the longest time print mode waits for background tasks before exiting, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROACTIVE
what: Passed to the terminal UI as its assistant mode. By the name, it turns on proactive behaviour there.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER
what: Sets the command used to wrap processes the client launches. The client sets it from the processWrapper setting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROFILE_STARTUP
what: Records startup profiling for every session instead of a sample.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECTS_SESSION
what: Turns on the same URL-tracking path as the tengu_rosy_flute gate and passes one related tool check. Going by the name, it marks a session started from a project.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME
what: Sets the name of the project directory used to store this project's sessions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL
what: Sets the prompt cache TTL for main-session requests, ahead of the promptCacheTtl setting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROPAGATE_TRACEPARENT
what: Propagates the trace context to non-first-party endpoints and child processes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST
what: Tells the client that the host configures the model provider. Provider variables from settings are then ignored.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER_TTL_MS
what: Sets how long a value from the proxy auth helper is cached, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS
what: Leaves DNS resolution to the proxy.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PWSH_PARSE_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for parsing PowerShell commands, in milliseconds (default 5000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_QUESTION_EXTENDED
what: For some entrypoints and for remote sessions, it turns on one setting at startup. By the name, that setting is the extended AskUserQuestion form.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_QUESTION_OPTIONAL_DESCRIPTIONS
what: Going by its name, it makes the option descriptions in AskUserQuestion optional. The client applies it only for some entrypoints and in remote sessions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_QUESTION_PREVIEW_FORMAT
what: Sets the preview format for AskUserQuestion, "markdown" or "html". The SDK sets it from its options.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_TIER
what: Gives the rate-limit tier of the account. The client sets it from a background session's auth snapshot.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK_CATCH_ALL
what: A truthy value makes every refusal eligible for the fallback model and a falsy value turns that off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RELAUNCH_HOME_TRUST
what: Carries workspace trust for the home directory across a relaunch. The client sets it before it relaunches.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RELAUNCH_TERMINAL_SIZE
what: Holds the terminal size the client records before it relaunches. The next start restores that size.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE
what: Marks the process as a cloud (remote) session. Many behaviours branch on it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE
what: Holds the type of remote environment, such as "self_hosted".

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_HERMETIC_MODE
what: By its name, it runs a remote session hermetically. It counts only when CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE is also set.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_MEMORY_DIR
what: Names the memory directory for a remote session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SEND_KEEPALIVES
what: Sends keepalive activity signals from a remote session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID
what: Holds the id of the remote session the process belongs to.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ORIGIN
what: Gives the origin of a remote session. The value "review" marks a review session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_TOOLS_FORWARD
what: By its name, it turns on forwarding of remote tools. Only the value true counts.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_TOOLS_PIN_STORED_LOGIN
what: Pins the remote tools serve helper to the stored login.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REPORT_FINDINGS
what: Lets a review report findings with the ReportFindings tool.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_REPO_CHECKOUTS
what: The client parses it as a map that, by its name, pairs repositories with their checkout directories. With more than one entry, the current repository picks the directory.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED
what: A truthy value turns on what the name calls restricted mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESULT_NONCE
what: Adds a nonce to the result. The client reads it once at startup and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_FROM_SESSION
what: Names the session whose transcript a new remote session is hydrated from.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN
what: Tells a respawned session to resume a turn that was interrupted. The launcher sets it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS
what: Sets the maximum age, in milliseconds, of an interrupted turn that is resumed. The default is 3600000 and 0 removes the limit.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_PROMPT
what: Sets the prompt sent when resuming an interrupted turn (default "Continue from where you left off.").

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_REASON
what: Holds the reason recorded when resuming an interrupted turn (default "interrupted_turn").

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_SOURCE_ALIVE
what: Tells a resumed session whether the session it resumes is still running.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
what: Sets the idle minutes after which the resume-return prompt can show (default 70).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_TOKEN_THRESHOLD
what: Sets the minimum context tokens for the resume-return prompt (default 100000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_TOLERATES_CONTEXT_APPENDS
what: Makes resuming tolerate context appended after an interrupted turn.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
what: Turns on the retry watchdog for API requests.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_RUSTLING_PIXEL
what: Picks "all", "upgrade" or "none" for the behaviour behind tengu_rustling_pixel, on first-party hosts only. Any other value logs a warning and counts as "upgrade".

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE
what: When truthy, starts in safe mode (same as --safe-mode).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SANDBOXED
what: Tells the client it runs inside a sandbox. The client then treats the workspace as trusted.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS
what: Takes a JSON object of numeric limits, read once per process. By the name, the limits apply to scripts.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED
what: Sets the mouse-wheel scroll speed. The client writes the user's choice from the scroll speed setting into it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH
what: Tells the client the SDK host can refresh its auth token. The SDK sets it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_OAUTH_REFRESH
what: Tells the client the SDK host can refresh OAuth tokens. The SDK sets it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_READS_SESSION_STATE
what: Tells the client the SDK host reads session state events. The SDK sets it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SEND_FEEDBACK
what: A false value turns off sending feedback. Otherwise the server-side gate tengu_juniper_relay decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for SessionEnd hooks, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ACCESS_TOKEN
what: Gives the access token for the session ingress service. The client sets it after reading the token from a file descriptor.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED
what: Tells the client whether the session that spawned it is attended.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
what: Holds the session's own id. The client exports it to its children.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND
what: Gives the kind of session. The value "bg" marks a background session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_LOG
what: The client records it as the log path in the session's registry entry. Going by the name, it points at the session's log file.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_NAME
what: Holds the name of a background session, set by its launcher.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ORIGIN
what: Gives the origin of the session. The value "claude_ai_chat" marks a session started from claude.ai chat.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_START_ANNOUNCEMENTS_BEFORE_PROMPT
what: Places session-start announcements before the first prompt.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL
what: Sets the shell for the Bash tool. Only a working bash or zsh is accepted.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX
what: Sets the command prefix wrapped around every shell command the client runs.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SILENT_TURN_REMINDER
what: Turns the silent-turn reminder on or off. When it is unset, the model's configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SILENT_TURN_REMINDER_TEXT
what: Sets the text of the silent-turn reminder, ahead of the server-supplied text.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SILENT_TURN_REMINDER_TURNS
what: Sets the number of silent turns before the reminder, ahead of the server-supplied value.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE
what: When truthy, runs in bare mode, the same as --bare. The client also sets it for --bare.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
what: A truthy value forces the simple system prompt and a falsy value turns it off. When it is unset, the model and a server-side gate decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMULATE_PROXY_USAGE
what: When set, it changes a prompt-cache decision for main-thread and subagent requests. Its name suggests it imitates the usage accounting of a proxy.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL_ATTRIBUTION
what: Holds JSON entries that, by the name, attribute skills to a source. An entry that is not a JSON object is skipped.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL_PROPOSALS
what: Turns on system-prompt instructions that, by their name, let the model propose skills. It also enables a related tool in remote environments.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_ANTHROPIC_AWS_AUTH
what: Skips AWS authentication for Claude Platform on AWS (for a proxy that adds it).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD_AUTH
what: Skips Google Cloud authentication for Claude on Google Cloud.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_AWS_CRED_CACHE
what: Stops caching AWS credentials resolved for Bedrock.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH
what: Skips AWS authentication for Amazon Bedrock (for a proxy that adds it).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_NETWORK_ERRORS
what: Ignores network errors when checking whether fast mode is available.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK
what: Skips the organization check for fast mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FOUNDRY_AUTH
what: Skips Azure authentication for Microsoft Foundry.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH
what: Skips AWS authentication for Bedrock Mantle.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MODEL_ACCESS_MEMORY
what: Stops remembering which models a third-party account can use.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PLUGIN_MCP_SERVERS
what: Skips discovering MCP servers that plugins provide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PLUGIN_MCP_SERVERS_EXCEPT
what: Lists the plugins, separated by commas, whose MCP servers are still loaded when plugin MCP servers are skipped.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY
what: Stops recording prompts to history in a nested Claude Code process.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_VERTEX_AUTH
what: Skips Google authentication for Vertex AI.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SLOW_OPERATION_THRESHOLD_MS
what: Sets the duration above which an operation is logged as slow, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SPAWN_TIMESTAMP_MS
what: Holds the time the process was spawned, used to measure startup latency.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SQUISHY_NEWT
what: Overrides the gate tengu_squishy_newt in both directions. When it is unset the gate decides, with on as the default.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SSE_PORT
what: Gives the port of the IDE's server. When it is present, the client connects to the IDE.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS_FOR_TESTING
what: Sets the stall timeout for update downloads, for testing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_STARTUP_FAILURE_RESULTS
what: A truthy value, going by the name and the result builder beside it, reports startup failures as result messages on stream-json output.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_STELLAR_DRIFT
what: Overrides tengu_stellar_drift in both directions. When it is unset, CLAUDE_CODE_TETHER_LIVE turns it on, or else the gate decides with off as the default.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP
what: Sets the maximum times a Stop hook may block the stop in one turn (default 8).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_CACHE_EVICT
what: Evicts subagent prompt-cache entries. Otherwise the server-side gate tengu_subagent_cache_evict decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL
what: Sets the model for subagents. Both "inherit" and "default" mean the session model.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE
what: Forces CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL on every subagent, ignoring the model parameter.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL
what: Sets the prompt cache TTL for subagent requests, ahead of the subagentPromptCacheTtl setting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB
what: Removes credentials from the environments of subprocesses and is on by default in GitHub Actions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE
what: Gives the subscription type of the account. The client sets it from a background session's auth snapshot.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUPERVISED
what: By its name, a truthy value runs the client in supervised mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUPPRESS_SESSION_ATTRIBUTION
what: Removes the session link from commit and PR attribution.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS
what: Syncs plugins from the organization.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_BUFFERED_DOWNLOAD
what: Downloads synced plugins in one buffered request instead of a stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_DOWNLOAD_STALL_MS
what: Sets the stall timeout for plugin downloads, in milliseconds (default 60000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for installing synced plugins, in milliseconds (default 30000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for connecting synced plugins' MCP servers, in milliseconds (default 10000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL
what: Installs synced plugins before the first turn.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for the startup plugin install, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_REUSE_WITHIN_MS
what: Reuses a recent sync result if it is younger than this many milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SESSION_REFS
what: Turns on the plugin and skill sync paths, as CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS and CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS do. By its name, it syncs session references.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS
what: Syncs skills from the organization.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for installing synced skills, in milliseconds (default 30000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for waiting on the skills sync, in milliseconds (default 5000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHT
what: A falsy value turns off syntax highlighting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_GB_FEATURE
what: In a remote session, names a server-side feature whose value replaces the system prompt.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TAGS
what: Sets the tags attached to error reports.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID
what: Sets the id of the task list to use, instead of the team or session one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEAMMATE_COMMAND
what: By its name, it sets the command that starts a teammate process in place of the client's own binary.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEAM_TEARDOWN_PARK_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets how long team teardown waits for teammates to park, in milliseconds (default 10000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEE_SDK_STDOUT
what: Copies SDK stdout to the debug log.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TERMINAL_MCP_TOOLS
what: Lists MCP tool names, separated by commas, whose text input the client collects from tool calls. The name suggests these tools act as terminals.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEST_ALLOW_REAL_NETWORK
what: Allows real network requests from a test runtime.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TEST_FIXTURES_ROOT
what: Sets the root directory of recorded test fixtures.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TETHER_LIVE
what: Turns on live tethered threads on the first-party API and is read from its own small registry.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_THINKING_DISPLAY_UPDATES
what: Turns thinking display updates on or off (default on).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_THISTLE_GREBE
what: Chooses the steering variant, one of "default", "no_nudges" or "counter_steer". When it is unset, client data or the gate tengu_thistle_grebe decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_THRIFTY_SONIC
what: Overrides tengu_thrifty_sonic in both directions. When it is unset, the model's configuration forces it on or off, or the gate decides for a cohort.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR
what: Sets the temporary directory for files the client writes (default /tmp).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_PREFIX
what: Holds the tmux prefix key shown in the detach hint of a tmux session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_PREFIX_CONFLICTS
what: Tells the client its tmux prefix conflicts. The detach hint then says to press the prefix twice.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_SESSION
what: Names the tmux session the client runs in, shown in the status area.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_TRUECOLOR
what: Keeps 24-bit colour inside tmux instead of limiting to 256 colours.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TOASTY_THIMBLE
what: Overrides the per-model text of an ephemeral reminder that otherwise comes from client data.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TODO_REMINDER_MODE
what: Sets the todo reminder mode, "baseline" or "off". When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_CGROUP_EXCLUDE
what: Lists the tool classes, separated by commas, excluded from the tool memory cgroup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT
what: Sets the memory limit for tool subprocesses on Linux. A falsy value or "none" turns the limit off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TOTAL_TOKENS_REMINDER
what: Sets the mode of the total-tokens reminder, ahead of the totalTokensReminder setting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TOTAL_TOKENS_REMINDER_AFTER_USER_TURN
what: Sets whether the total-tokens reminder is sent after user turns, ahead of the setting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TOTAL_TOKENS_REMINDER_BUDGET
what: Sets the token budget for the total-tokens reminder, ahead of the setting.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC
what: In local non-interactive sessions, the value true turns on what the name calls local transcript garbage collection. It also overrides tengu_transcript_local_gc.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TRIGGER_ID
what: Holds the id of the trigger that started the session, recorded in telemetry.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TUI_JUST_SWITCHED
what: Records that the terminal UI mode was just switched (fullscreen or default), for the confirmation notice.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TUI_TRIAL
what: Starts a fullscreen trial. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_TURN_UPDATES
what: Turns the turn-updates communication instructions on or off. When it is unset, the model's configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ULTRAREVIEW_PREFLIGHT_FIXTURE
what: Supplies JSON used instead of the ultrareview preflight response, for testing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ULTRAREVIEW_QUOTA_FIXTURE
what: Supplies JSON used instead of the ultrareview quota response, for testing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for user dialogs in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL
what: Sets the email of the account, used with the account and organization uuids to seed account details.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS
what: Uses Claude Platform on AWS as the model provider.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD
what: Uses Claude on Google Cloud as the model provider.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
what: Uses Amazon Bedrock as the model provider.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_COWORK_PLUGINS
what: Uses the Cowork plugin settings file instead of settings.json.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY
what: Uses Microsoft Foundry as the model provider.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY
what: Uses a gateway as the model provider.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE
what: Uses Bedrock Mantle as the model provider.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL
what: Turns the PowerShell tool on or off. Outside Windows, only a true value turns it on.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX
what: Uses Google Vertex AI as the model provider.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_VOICE_FORWARD_INTERIMS_TYPED
what: Forwards interim voice transcripts as typed text. Otherwise the server-side gate tengu_brick_follow decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS
what: Sets how long WebFetch results are cached, in milliseconds (default 900000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS
what: Sets the overall deadline for a WebFetch call, in milliseconds. When it is unset, a server-side value applies.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_USE_CCR_PROXY
what: Sends WebFetch requests through the cloud session proxy.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEBSEARCH_USE_CCR_PROXY
what: Sends web searches through the cloud session proxy.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEBSOCKET_AUTH_FILE_DESCRIPTOR
what: Sets the file descriptor from which the websocket auth token is read at startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_FETCH_AGENT
what: Turns the WebFetch agent on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_FAST_ARG
what: Turns the fast argument for web search on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WHIMSICAL_ELEPHANT
what: Overrides tengu_whimsical_elephant in both directions. When it is unset the gate decides, with off as the default.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WILLOW_TERN
what: A truthy value forces on tengu_willow_tern. When it is unset, client data, the model's opus_5_prompt_bundle setting and the gate decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WISE_COMET
what: Turns on or off a stripping step tied to tengu_wise_comet. When it is unset, the step runs only with adaptive thinking and only when the gate is on.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_CHECKIN_SCHEDULE
what: Sets the check-in times for background workers, in seconds and separated by commas.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_EPOCH
what: Holds the epoch number of a remote worker, reported to the host.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOWS
what: Turns workflows on or off, though a server-side gate and the enableWorkflows setting can still turn them off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS
what: Sets the maximum agents a workflow runs at once.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS
what: Sets the stagger between workflow agents sharing a prompt prefix, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SIZE_WARNING_AGENTS
what: Sets the agent count above which a workflow size warning shows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SIZE_WARNING_TOKENS
what: Sets the token count above which a workflow size warning shows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKSPACE_HOST_PATHS
what: Holds the host paths of the workspace, separated by "|", recorded in telemetry.

name: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
what: Sets the directory for configuration and data instead of ~/.claude and also moves the global config file.

name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_EXTRA_GUIDELINES
what: Adds extra guidelines to the auto memory instructions.

name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES
what: Supplies memory guidelines from the Cowork host. When they are present, memory switches to file mode.

name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_INDEX_CONTENT
what: Supplies memory index content from the Cowork host, used instead of the file on disk.

name: CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_PATH_OVERRIDE
what: Supplies a memory path from the Cowork host.

name: CLAUDE_DEBUG
what: Logs Node warnings to the debug log.

name: CLAUDE_DISABLE_ADOPT
what: By its name, a truthy value turns off adopting work from other sessions on exit.

name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG
what: Turns the byte-level stream watchdog on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides (default on).

name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG_BEDROCK
what: Turns on the byte-level stream watchdog for Bedrock.

name: CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG
what: Turns the stream idle watchdog on or off (default on).

name: CLAUDE_ENV_FILE
what: Gives the path of a shell script whose contents are loaded into the session environment for Bash commands. The client sets it for hooks.

name: CLAUDE_FORCE_DISPLAY_SURVEY
what: Forces the feedback survey to show once.

name: CLAUDE_GATEWAY_ALLOW_LOOPBACK
what: Lets the gateway connect to loopback addresses and also cancels the egress-boundary mode.

name: CLAUDE_GATEWAY_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets how long the gateway waits for open requests when shutting down (default 25000 ms).

name: CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_LEVEL
what: Sets the log level of the gateway (debug, info, warn or error, default info).

name: CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY
what: Treats the configured HTTPS proxy as the egress boundary and has the gateway leave hostname checks to it.

name: CLAUDE_IMPORT_CONVERSATIONS
what: Turns on the import-conversations command.

name: CLAUDE_INTERNAL_ASSISTANT_TEAM_NAME
what: Hands a team name to an assistant session from its parent. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_INTERNAL_FC_OVERRIDES
what: Serves as the feature-flag client's source of overrides, a source this build never consults. The plugin eval command sets it for its child process.

name: CLAUDE_JOB_DIR
what: Names the directory of the background job this process belongs to, where exit causes and details are written.

name: CLAUDE_LOCAL_OAUTH_API_BASE
what: Sets the API base URL for local OAuth development (default http://localhost:8000).

name: CLAUDE_LOCAL_OAUTH_APPS_BASE
what: Sets the apps base URL for local OAuth development (default http://localhost:4000).

name: CLAUDE_LOCAL_OAUTH_CONSOLE_BASE
what: Sets the console base URL for local OAuth development (default http://localhost:3000).

name: CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES
what: Sets the memory stores to mount. When it is set, organization memory is not used.

name: CLAUDE_PROJECT_UUID
what: When policy allows it, it enables the Projects tool for the session's attached claude.ai project. By the name, the value is that project's uuid.

name: CLAUDE_PTY_HEARTBEAT_MS
what: Sets the heartbeat interval of the terminal host, in milliseconds (default 60000).

name: CLAUDE_PTY_HOST_EXEC
what: When 1, marks the process as a terminal host started by the client. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_PTY_ORPHAN_CHECK_MS
what: Sets the interval at which the terminal host checks whether it was orphaned, in milliseconds (default 2000).

name: CLAUDE_PTY_RECORD
what: Sets the path to which the terminal host records output.

name: CLAUDE_RELAUNCH_SESSION_ADD_DIRS
what: Carries extra directories across a relaunch. The client reads it once and then removes it.

name: CLAUDE_REMOTE_CONTROL_SESSION_NAME_PREFIX
what: Sets the prefix for Remote Control session names. The client also sets it from its option.

name: CLAUDE_REMOTE_WORKFLOW_ARGS
what: Holds JSON arguments for a workflow delivered to a remote session.

name: CLAUDE_REMOTE_WORKFLOW_SCRIPT
what: Delivers a workflow script to a remote session, where the remote workflow command runs it.

name: CLAUDE_RUNNER_ACTIVITY_FD
what: Names the file descriptor of a pipe on which the runner receives activity signals.

name: CLAUDE_RUNNER_API_BASE_URL
what: Gives the API base URL of the runner, used when the session ingress URL is unset.

name: CLAUDE_RUNNER_DISABLE_AWAITING_ACTION_OVERRIDE
what: Stops the runner from reporting awaiting-action when a child is parked at a prompt.

name: CLAUDE_RUNNER_FETCH_DEPTH
what: Sets the git fetch depth for runner checkouts. The values "full" and 0 mean a full fetch.

name: CLAUDE_RUNNER_SESSION_ID
what: Gives the session id of the runner, used when the remote session id is unset.

name: CLAUDE_RUNNER_SKIP_GIT_VERIFY
what: When 1, skips verifying the runner checkout's .git directory.

name: CLAUDE_RUNNER_USE_GIT_PROXY
what: Routes the runner's git traffic through Anthropic's git proxy.

name: CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR
what: Sets the directory for the secure credential store, instead of the config directory.

name: CLAUDE_SESSION_INGRESS_TOKEN_FILE
what: Gives the path of the session ingress token file.

name: CLAUDE_SLOW_FIRST_BYTE_MS
what: Sets the time without a first stream chunk after which a slow-first-byte warning is logged (default 30000 ms).

name: CLAUDE_STAGE_FILE_ROOT
what: Sets the absolute root directory for staged files and outputs.

name: CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for the first byte of a stream, clamped between 10 seconds and 30 minutes.

name: CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the stream idle timeout in milliseconds (at least 300000).

name: CLAUDE_TMPDIR
what: Sets the temporary directory for sandboxed commands when CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR is unset. If this variable is unset too, the client fills it from the sandbox's directory.

name: CLAUDE_TRUSTED_DEVICE_TOKEN
what: Supplies the trusted-device token, without which a cloud session cannot use features that require a trusted device.

name: CLAUDE_WORKFLOW_NAME_ONLY
what: Lists workflows by name only.

name: CLIPBOARD_NAPI_NODE_PATH
what: Names the path of the native clipboard module. In this build the loader returns before it reads the value.

name: CLOUDSDK_ACTIVE_CONFIG_NAME
what: Names the active gcloud configuration. It forms part of the key that decides whether the Google credential refresh runs again.

name: CLOUDSDK_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN
what: Supplies a Google Cloud access token. Its presence counts as an existing credential when the client probes providers.

name: CLOUDSDK_CONFIG
what: Names the gcloud configuration directory. It forms part of the key that decides whether the Google credential refresh runs again.

name: CLOUDSDK_CORE_CUSTOM_CA_CERTS_FILE
what: Sets the CA bundle path for gcloud. The client reads it when collecting CA bundles and sets it in sandboxed subprocess environments.

name: CLOUD_ML_REGION
what: Sets the region for Vertex AI (default us-east5).

name: CLOUD_RUN_JOB
what: Its presence tells the bundled Google auth library it runs on Cloud Run Jobs.

name: CODER
what: When truthy, marks the environment as Coder.

name: CODER_WORKSPACE_NAME
what: Its presence marks the environment as Coder.

name: CODESPACES
what: When truthy, marks the environment as GitHub Codespaces.

name: COLORFGBG
what: Holds the terminal colours, used to guess a dark or light background.

name: COLORTERM
what: When unset on a terminal below truecolor, a tip suggests setting COLORTERM=truecolor.

name: COMPUTERNAME
what: Holds the Windows computer name, used as the machine name.

name: COMSPEC
what: Names the Windows command interpreter, used to identify the shell when SHELL is unset. The client also reads it under the spelling ComSpec.

name: CONTAINER_SANDBOX_MOUNT_POINT
what: On Windows, its presence marks a container sandbox, where the client does not permit its registry sweep.

name: CURL_CA_BUNDLE
what: Sets a CA bundle path that is read when collecting CA bundles.

name: CURSOR_TRACE_ID
what: Its presence marks the terminal as Cursor's.

name: ConEmuANSI
what: Its presence marks the terminal as ConEmu.

name: ConEmuPID
what: Its presence marks the terminal as ConEmu.

name: ConEmuTask
what: Its presence marks the terminal as ConEmu.

name: DAYTONA_WS_ID
what: Its presence marks the environment as Daytona.

name: DEBUG
what: Sets debug namespaces for the bundled debug library. A truthy value also turns on debug mode.

name: DEBUG_AUTH
what: Makes the bundled Google auth library log metadata-server errors.

name: DEBUG_CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK
what: Writes an Agent SDK debug log file.

name: DEBUG_SDK
what: Turns on debug mode.

name: DEFAULT_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID
what: Sets the client id for system-assigned managed identity in the bundled Azure identity library.

name: DEMO_VERSION
what: Sets a version string shown in demos instead of the real one and also hides the working directory.

name: DENO_CERT
what: Sets the CA bundle path for Deno. When the client supplies its own CA bundle, it sets this variable in sandboxed subprocess environments.

name: DENO_DEPLOYMENT_ID
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as Deno Deploy.

name: DETECT_GCP_RETRIES
what: Sets the number of retries for Google Cloud metadata detection in the bundled Google auth library.

name: DEVPOD
what: When truthy, marks the environment as DevPod.

name: DEVPOD_WORKSPACE_UID
what: Its presence marks the environment as DevPod.

name: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER
what: Turns off automatic updates.

name: DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT
what: Turns off automatic compaction.

name: DISABLE_BRIEF_MODE_STOP_HOOK
what: Turns off the stop hook that brief mode adds.

name: DISABLE_BUG_COMMAND
what: Turns off the /bug command.

name: DISABLE_COMPACT
what: Turns off compaction entirely.

name: DISABLE_COST_WARNINGS
what: Turns off cost warnings.

name: DISABLE_DOCTOR_COMMAND
what: Turns off the /doctor command.

name: DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING
what: Turns off error reporting.

name: DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND
what: Turns off the extra usage command.

name: DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND
what: Turns off the /feedback command.

name: DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK
what: Turns off feature-flag fetching. Every feature flag then falls back to its default.

name: DISABLE_INSTALLATION_CHECKS
what: Turns off installation checks.

name: DISABLE_INSTALL_GITHUB_APP_COMMAND
what: Turns off the /install-github-app command.

name: DISABLE_INTERLEAVED_THINKING
what: Stops sending the interleaved-thinking beta header.

name: DISABLE_LOGIN_COMMAND
what: Turns off the /login command.

name: DISABLE_LOGOUT_COMMAND
what: Turns off the /logout command.

name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING
what: Turns off prompt caching.

name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_FABLE
what: Turns off prompt caching for Fable models.

name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU
what: Turns off prompt caching for Haiku models.

name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_MYTHOS
what: Turns off prompt caching for Mythos models.

name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS
what: Turns off prompt caching for Opus models.

name: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET
what: Turns off prompt caching for Sonnet models.

name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
what: Turns off telemetry.

name: DISABLE_UPDATES
what: Turns off updates.

name: DISABLE_UPGRADE_COMMAND
what: Turns off the upgrade command.

name: DISPLAY
what: Names the X11 display. The client uses it to detect whether a graphical session is available.

name: DO_NOT_TRACK
what: When truthy, turns off telemetry.

name: DYNO
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as Heroku.

name: EDITOR
what: Sets the preferred editor when VISUAL is unset.

name: ENABLE_BETA_TRACING_DETAILED
what: Turns on detailed beta tracing when BETA_TRACING_ENDPOINT is set, though a server-side gate can still veto.

name: ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS
what: A falsy value turns off MCP connectors from claude.ai.

name: ENABLE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA
what: Turns on the enhanced telemetry beta when CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA is unset.

name: ENABLE_MCP_LARGE_OUTPUT_FILES
what: A false value truncates large MCP results instead of writing them to files.

name: ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H
